notes.title: Patch v36.15
notes.content:
//misc changes
- A 1600x900 Screen Resolution option has been added.
- When Sealing a minion that needs a Hero Soul Boneraise its Seal description text will now state this (so you don't think it's a bug when the Sealed minion doesn't show in the next regular Boneraise).
- Hub - Class Heritage menu: You now change classes by moving to the edge of the menu (instead of the weird key combo press which doesn't show correctly when using non-english texts).
- Mausoleum Awakens: Contraptions destroyed by the falling King will now be re-created when starting a new New Game Plus loop (instead of being replaced by an empty grave which makes it look like a bug).
- Curse of Blindness: Enemies that are near the edge of the screen will now suffer from the Confusion status effect (so the Curse isn't all bad).

//bug fixes
- Settings - Controls - Mouse: Changing the assigned buttons was scuffed and could crash.
- Settings - Visibility - Screen Saturation: When using the CRT screen effect the Saturation setting wasn't working.
- Settings - Visibility - Player Health Bar: It could jiggle about when using the CRT screen effect.
- Mausoleum Awakens - Accursed Cathedral map: Some blue parts of King Gigald weren't changing to the correct purple colour.
- Mausoleum Awakens: Some parts of King Gigald weren't changing to the correct colour for special variants (eg Cursed).
- Creative Plaything: Changing Class would freeze the game (the more minions you have the longer the freeze).
- Creative Plaything: The New Game Plus text was being referred to as New Game Forever.
- Boneraise Lore meta - Keepsake Key: It could choose a random Relic that the class already starts with (which meant you wouldn't get anything).
- Hub: Deleting your Meta Progression then interacting with the Memory Skull could cause a crash.
- Hub - Class Heritage menu: When using Full Mouse Support the Souls number was mis-aligned if you weren't hovering over an active part of the menu.
- Slop Pot contraption: Its base floor decoration wasn't showing in some maps.
- Beast Whisperer class: Some of its Tamed minions that bounce could suddenly change direction when in mid-air during its idling loop.
- Impling Trapper / Volt Coiler / Joker Jester: Sealing it's Deamon upgrade would show it in the next normal Boneraise.
- Tamed Bouncy Warble minion: It was using a small floor shadow sprite.
- Bulok Rider / Ghoul enemy: Some of their colours weren't affected by colour palette swaps (eg Blessed).
- Tinkerer's Toolbox relic: There was a chance of it not spawning a trap if you were stood near to a lot of terrain.
- Spellious Spewious spell: There was a small chance of it giving spells that have been Banished.
- Drain Boner spell: If you had a lot of minions then there was a chance it wouldn't find a Boner to drain.

//translation file changes
- Added IDs: ChooseItem_SealedNextSoul
- Removed IDs: MnSet_Gen_Fullscaling, MnSet_Gen_Opt12, MnSet_Gen_Tip12, Status_Blind, MtCl_ChangeClass

notes.title: Patch v36.14
notes.content:
//misc changes
- The game engine has been updated to the latest version of GameMaker (v2024.8.1).
- On the starting Greetings menu where you choose a control scheme you can now press the Escape key to bypass it.
- Elven Warfinder boss: His basic arrows have been slightly slowed down (especially the Poison arrows).

//bug fixes
- When deleting your Meta Progression via the Setting's Delete Save menu it wasn't deleting some save data (Creative Plaything, Memory Skull, Saved Run, Magic Mirror).
- Contraptions: If you were running past an interactable contraption and pressed the Dash button then the contraption would trigger if the Dash was on a cool down.
- High Wizard boss: Getting killed by his normal fireball attack would say you were killed by King Gigald on the game over screen.
- Hub - Minion Boneways: The Giantous was labeled as Sinner.

notes.title: Patch v36.13
notes.content:
//misc changes
- The music album has been removed from the game folder (since it's available as DLC).
- Visibility Settings - Vignette: When set to Off the screen effect during Curses is now reduced.
- Button Tips - Keyboard: Changed the icon for the Space key (so it looks more like a Space key).
- Hub: When playing as a random class you now visually swap class every other second when inside the Hub (as a reminder you're playing as a random class).
- Traveller Event - Curse Wracked: It will now say what the currently selected Curse will do.
- Traveller Event - Master Baiter: They can now also sell: Ratty Orbica, Zombie, Ghost Watcher, Ghost Summoner, Lantern Handler, Candle Ghost, Bestial Boy, Werewolf. They now have a very small chance of selling a Sumptuous Slime. They can no longer sell Ogres.
- Traveller Event - Hired Swole: They can now also sell: Ogre, Boulder Ogre, Cannibal. They now have a small chance of selling Paladins.

//bug fixes
- There was a chance the stage music could cut out if played for a while.
- Status Screen: When using Full Mouse Support moving the mouse wheel could cause a crash if you had a lot of minions/relics.
- Traveller Event: when using Full Mouse Support moving the mouse wheel could cause a crash.
- Boneraise Screen: when using Full Mouse Support moving the mouse wheel could use a Seal/Banish.
- Boneraise Lore: When using Full Mouse Support the Dabber Dash, Majikoumal Parchment, and Journal Gnoblin, button tips were showing the keyboard buttons (instead of mouse buttons).
- Settings - Visibility - Full Frontal Meanies: Some enemy attacks were ignoring this setting.
- Fetid/Ginormous Pumpkin contraptions: If they reached the end of their regrowth but you were standing on them then their sprite would flash.
- Eggy Bro minion: If it hatched into a Tamed Beast there was a chance it wouldn't show its name/icon in the Status Screen.
- Barrow Bonebolster spell: It could choose a minion that could not be upgraded due to its next level being Banished.

notes.title: Patch v36.12
notes.content:
//misc changes
- The game engine has been updated to the latest version of GameMaker (v2024.6.2).
- MELDIN TIME achievement: This can now be done using the Meldum Afflicted class.
- Castle Conquest - stage 11: Reduced the amount of Wizardly Seers that spawn. The Wizarding Councilor's fast fireballs are now slower.
- Giantous Gladiator minion: Increased his sight range, move speed, attack speed, and attack damage.
- Master Baiter traveller event: He can now offer Bulok Riders and Blossom Dryads.
- Meaty Wallop / Flesh Cube relics: Their push-back effect now works against the Royal Guard and Custodianly Champion enemies.
- Desecrated Rage / Acuity / Mysticism relics: These now also slightly increase the chance of being offered an appropriate Bro minion.

//bug fixes
- Playing the game without the Steam Launcher running would eventually cause a crash.
- Vampire Escapade achievement: This wasn't triggering at the correct time if you had a Creamy Trifle relic.
- Castle Conquest: Loading a previous run that had saved just after beating the Queen would cause a crash.
- When starting a run there was a rare chance of a "variable index [-4] out of range" crash.
- Impling Trapper minion: There was a rare chance their Bow traps could cause a crash.
- Ghost Watcher/Summoner enemy: There was a chance of them causing a softlock if they summon ghosts offscreen.
- There was a chance minion's Damage Per Second stat would show as inf/s.
- Settings - Visibility - Full Frontal Meanies: Some enemy attacks were ignoring this setting.
- Hub - Memory Skull: When viewing a saved death stats the Thy Legion title could be wrong if you switched classes.
- Creative Plaything: The Psycho Possessed's class switching meta would sometimes not trigger correctly.
- Some pickups wouldn't be sucked to you if they were partially outside the level.
- Psycho Possessed class: When switching to the Sorcerer Hollow class his Bookshelf Familiar could spawn in a wall.
- Benevolent Augur minion: They could cast Haste on you at Level 1/2.
- Giantous Gianraiser minion: Their Behemoth Miner summons were ignoring the Ghostly Minions visibility setting.
- Spirit Whispers relic: If you had multiple Soul Holder contraptions then a Hero Soul pickup could fill 2 Holders.
- Barrow Bonebolster spell: When leveling up a minion it was ignoring minion Banishments.
- Regrowth Returnal spell: When cast during a boss fight it wasn't immediately recharging contraptions.
- High Wizard boss: Getting killed by his normal fireball attack would say you were killed by King Gigald on the game over screen.
- King Gigald: During his explosive balls attack there was a rare chance of his balls not exploding unless you touched them.

- Status Screen: Some level 3 Skelly minions now have a new description (previously they would use their level 1 boneraise description which could omit level 3 abilities eg the Voodoo Witch's Deathen Curse).

notes.title: Patch v36.6
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Majick Doppelganger: Their code base now uses the Player's spell casting code instead of their own separate minion casting code. Gameplay-wise you shouldn't notice a difference though there's little bits and bobs changes (eg minions casting the Pumpkined Comets spell can now spawn the bigger pumpkins). The main difference is under the hood their code is now a lot cleaner and consistent.

//bug fixes
- Sacrificeous Brozillous spell: This would cause a crash if cast by the Player.
- Majick Doppelganger minion: They would cause a crash if cast the Drain Boner spell.
- Bodily Fluids spell: This could replace Spellious Hero Soul pickups that were on the floor.
- Mimicry Tears spell: Some of the Waxen minion colours weren't correct.

notes.title: Patch v36.5
notes.content:
//misc changes
- A new Visibility setting has been added called Full Frontal Meanies which when On shows enemies above everything else (eg your minions and terrain).
- Settings - Visibility: The options are now better organised with each page having their own title and appropriate options.
- The "translation_reference.csv" file has been updated (added: MnWrd_Minions, MnWrd_Pickups, MnWrd_Screen, MnWrd_Misc).
- Creative Plaything game mode: This will now permanently unlock once its unlocked once (in case you want to test things without full meta).
- The messages that can show at the bottom of the screen can now show up to 3 at the same time (so they don't overwrite each other).
- Majick Doppelganger / Waxen Wizard minions: Their available spell pool now includes every spell (though the more powerful spells have a very low chance).
- Blasphemous Trinket relic: Clarified its description (so its clear "Heavenly Vessels" are meanies).
- Blasphemous Prayers spell: Clarified its description (so its clear "Heavenly Vessels" are meanies).

//bug fixes
- Boneraiser Lore - Boned Burrows: At level 3 it could give minions you may have Banished.
- Heroic Force - Roaming Travellers meta: The traveller event being triggered when you're currently a Snowman could cause issues.
- Gangly Grafted class - Behemoth Friendship meta: Barrow Boners could raise as Behemoth Barrowers even if you had reached the max Giant cap.
- Liche Necromancer class - Divergent Force meta: It wasn't showing the second line of its description.
- Cyclop Exile class: When offered to hire the Colossus Cyclops it was showing a minion limit.

notes.title: Boned Bits and Bobs Update #36
notes.content:
Welcome back you filthy boneraisers. Today's update is a very general odds and sods with oodles of improvements all over the place based on the feedback I've had since the last update from you, yes YOU!

[b]Visual tweaks to improve visibility...[/b]
- All player class sprites are now 1 pixel taller and a bit brighter (couldn't resist tweaking some a bit too, eg Gangly is even taller and Clown has longer shoes).
- All Enemies are now a bit brighter (notably the darker ones like Bandits/Cyclops).
- Enemy Arrow projectiles are now brighter and all enemy projectiles will now show on top of everything else (eg terrain).
- Enemies with a ranged attack now have to be fully onscreen before they can attack you.
- The various human Champions and Royal Guard have had a few sprite tweaks so are easier to see (eg they are 1 pixel taller, bigger weapon/shield, etc).
- Map floors are now a bit darker and contraptions/walls a bit brighter.
- You no longer create smoke clouds when running outside of the Hub.
- Settings - Visibility - Declutter Floor: This setting has been removed as it now either always counts as being On or uses the Ghostly Minions setting.

[b]Crypt Hub changes...[/b]
- 5 new hats have been added (though are more big head replacements instead of hats): Bigly Barrowerer, Eggplantty Broski, Pumpkinny Broski, Turnippy Broski, Potty Broski.
- Fabellia now has some buyable decorations used to spruce up the Hub. These include a welcome mat, torches, blinged up throne, statue, and boned up or overgrown aesthetic. She also now looks after the Crypt Paints and the way she discovers fashions is now random (so works like Goblusious). The Crypt Paint colours have had some tweaks so are a bit brighter and nicer colours.
- The Memory Skull is now used to load in-progress runs (instead of being asked when starting a new run). The saving is now also done automatically with a tip popup to indicate this (instead of being asked to save every time).
- The Magic Mirror can now set your fashion to global or class specific, so you can individually set your hat, cloak colour, and crypt decorations, to apply to either all classes or just the current class.

[b]Castle Conquest game mode changes...[/b]
- The game mode is now unlocked after beating the King and there's now a tutorial ghost that shows up in the Hub when unlocked.
- Stage 1 now takes place in a new map behind your crypt (so you can now set up a Contraption layout specifically for the Conquest game mode).
- Stage 11 now takes place in a new Wizarding Librarium where endless Seers and a Wizarding Council await.
- Stage 10 now uses the old stage 11 Town. The start of the stage now has some Custodian Bowmen and regular Custodians show up.
- Stage 9 now uses the old stage 10 Bastion and has some new art.
- The stage 12 Lift will now have either a Lunatic Fanatic or Werewolf Prince boss drop in (or both in New Game Plus). The amount of enemies that spawn has increased by +20%. The falling bombs and their explosions are now bigger (so easier to see). In New Game Plus it now has 4 Giga Treasure Chests instead of regular Treasure Chests.
- During a stage if you don't have the special enemy meta then it will now just skip that phase (instead of defaulting to a Peasant wave).
- The Stage Complete screen now shows your Score and how much Score you earnt that stage.
- When selecting a path to travel to if you don't have the meta unlocked for an enemy stage then it will now show a padlock and warning text.
- When entering a New Game Plus it will now immediately save the run (instead of having to complete the first stage to save).

[b]Mausoleum Awakens game mode changes...[/b]
- You now get an extra 61 Coin meta within the first 111 seconds of play (just to speed up the very early game a bit).
- The Map's contraptions will now carry over into the next New Game Plus loop (mainly only relevant for the Imp class).
- When playing a Forsaken Cemetery map the top terrain will now use your Crypt Paint colour.

[b]Achievement changes...[/b]
- A new achievement has been added called Conquest Filthy Stinkin Rich which is for scoring 666,666+ in Castle Conquest.
- The existing Royalty Bosshunter has now been split into 2 separate achievements, one for pounding the King, and the other the Queen (note the King one replaces the existing achievement so you may already have it).
- The various class related Gigald/Gigalicious Pounder achievements are now based on attaining a score instead of just winning the run (to add some strategy rather than mindlessly grinding out safe runs).
- Some of the Mausoleum Awakens challenge runs can now be done in Castle Conquest if you prefer to pound Queeny (Royalty Bosshunter Plus, MELDIN TIME, Horoscopeophobia, Alzheimer Survivor, I Don't Even Know Who I Am).
- Mausoleum High Scorer: You now need to score 444,444+ (instead of 333,333+).
- Horoscopeophobia: If you don't yet have this achievement then when choosing a boneraise/relic/spell there's now 4 little dots in the top right to signify you can still get the achievement that run.

[b]Boneraise Lore meta changes...[/b]
- Chi Chakra: At level 3 it now creates a shockwave if you were touched by an enemy and that hit would kill you (recharges every 99 seconds). The old level 3 effect which boosts the size of the shockwave and adds damage is now considered to be always active. The shockwave will now nullify the enemy's move speed (so now high speed enemies are pushed back at the same rate as low speed enemies).

[b]Heroic Force meta changes...[/b]
- Standards Unfurl: At level 3 it will now double the amount of bodyguards it spawns with. The old level 3 is now bundled into level 2.
- Yer A Wizard: At level 3 the Wizard will now spawn with some Wizardly Seer bodyguards. The old level 3 is now bundled into level 2.
- I Challenge Thee: At level 3 the Champion will now spawn with some fighter bodyguards. The old level 3 is now bundled into level 2.

[b]Player class changes...[/b]
- Sorcerer Hollow: A new meta has been added called Bookshelf Familiar which spawns a portable Bookshelf minion so you can cycle through your spells whenever you like (to make room for this the Occulto Bookwormios meta has been combined with Ensorcellous Memories).
- Courtier Clown - Sticky the Stupendous meta: Sticky will now demand a volunteer so you can no longer decline his magic trick (tee hee).
- Courtier Clown: A new meta has been added called Two-way Mirrors where every 69 (nice) seconds a map contraption is randomly transformed into another contraption.
- Sprout Brotatoes: A new meta of sorts has been added called Heady Sproutage which replaces the 3 existing Sproutage which allows you to grow Bro heads. It also now allows you to grow a Pot head.
- Sprout Brotatoes: A new meta has been added called Embiggen Sproutage which allows you to make your existing Bro head sprout bigger which boosts its benefits.
- Sprout Brotatoes: A new meta has been added called Bonebrobigly Singleton which can allow you to sacrifice a level 3 Skelly when offered a Bonebrobigly Destineous.
- Sprout Brotatoes: A new meta has been added called Soulen Brozilla which summons a temporary Brodacious Brozilla minion when picking up a Hero Soul.
- Doll Maker: A new meta has been added called Waxpiles Gobbler which raises 2 random unupgraded minions when picking up a Hero Soul and boosts chance of being offered Bonepiles Destineous (to make room for this the Waxenmould Flagbearer/Begger meta have been combined).
- Doll Maker: When playing a New Game Plus loop all minion contact damage is boosted by +11% per loop (they seemed a bit underpowered in later loops).
- Doll Maker: They can now use the Ethereal Rage/Acuity/Mysticism relics.
- Doll Maker: The Bonerous Destineous boneraise can now raise a Beggar Bomber, Elven Enchantress, or a level 2 Custodian. Each of the minions now have an equal chance of being chosen (previously it was weighted towards lesser minions).
- Doll Maker: The Eggy Bro minions spawned by the Brodacious Brozilla minion can now contain Custodians.
- Beast Whisperer: A new meta has been added called Meatpiles Scrounger which raises 2 random unupgraded minions when picking up a Hero Soul and boosts chance of being offered Bonepiles Destineous (to make room for this the Bestial Subdue/Aura meta have been combined).
- Beast Whisperer: When playing a New Game Plus loop all minion contact damage is boosted by +11% per loop (they seemed a bit underpowered in later loops).
- Beast Whisperer: They can now use the Ethereal Rage/Acuity/Mysticism relics.
- Gangly Grafted: A new meta has been added called Brodified Behemoths which can allow you to use a Behemoth Barrower for Bonebrobigly Destineous (to make room for this 1 of the Giantous Girth has been combined).
- Psycho Possessed: A new meta has been added called Soulen Boobroski which summons temporary Big Boobroski Bro minions when picking up a Hero Soul.
- Vampire Survivor: A new meta has been added called Batty Blood Bath which boosts all Healing based on how many Batty minions you have (to make room for this the Raise Batspellious meta has been combined with Batty Party).

[b]Changes to contraptions...[/b]
- Architect Mode: It will now show the Recharge time for the selected contraption.
- The Giga Treasure Chest has been added as a new contraption.
- Reflection Pool: This can now be used to end an active Curse. You now have to interact with it (instead of just running into it).
- Oaken Tree: This will now spawn its own mini-flocks of Bone Birds (so they will still show up even if you haven't unlocked "The Birds And The Bees" meta).
- Scarecrow Rascal: This now also boosts the chance of being offered Chupacabro minions by +20%. Its max limit has been reduced to 3 (from 4).
- Soulen Receptacle: This will now transport the Hero Soul to the receptacle (instead of sucking it which was rather annoying if you were in the way).
- Sinful Artifact: This will now fully unbless the enemy (previously it only reduced the Blessing by -1). Its recharge speed has been boosted by 25%.
- Blessful Artifact: This will now only Bless an enemy that is not yet Blessed (eg it can't make Super Blessed enemies).
- Cadaver Coffin: The chance of it containing a normal minion has increased to 75%. It will now contain a Barrow Boner instead of being empty. Its recharge speed has been boosted by 50%. Its max limit has been reduced to 2 (from 3). Its cost has increased to 250.
- Junk Box: This will now always contain a random Relic. It can now recharge after being activated.
- Lexicanium Archive: This is now used to store a Spell (this is swapped over from the Book Shelf). The Archive now starts the run containing a random Spell. Its cost has been reduced to 500.
- Book Shelf: This is now used to cycle through your Spells (this is swapped over from the Lexicanium Archive). Its cost has been increased to 150.
- Spellious Tome: You now have to interact with it to get the free Spell (it starts interactable). It now says the name of the Spell it gives when you take it.
- Cursed Eyeball: You now have to interact with it to trigger the Curse (it starts interactable).
- Restless Monolith: This can now recharge after being activated. Its max limit has been reduced to 2 (from 3).
- Sacrilegious Altar: This can now recharge after being activated. Its max limit has been increased to 2 (from 1).
- Fungal Growth: The Blight they inflict on enemies now lasts twice as long.
- Spiked Trap: Its attack cool-down has been reduced by 150%.
- Gravestone Grace: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 45%.
- Slop Pot: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 50%, however its Mud Pools dissipate 25% faster.
- Fetid Pumpkin: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 300%.
- Ginormous Pumpkin: It now creates an extra exploding piece. The exploding pieces now create their own fires. Its recharge speed has been boosted by 300%.
- Boning Totem: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 100%.
- Honeycomb Beehive: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 25%.
- Treasured Chesty: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 25%.
- Bushy Fruit: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 35%.
- Magic Stone: Its cost has been increased to 250 (from 175).
- Curse Eye: Its cost has reduced to 666 (from 1000).
- Peeky Potatocrow: Its max limit has been increased to 6 (from 4).

[b]Changes to Boneraise Necromancy...[/b]
- A new boneraise item has been added called Bonepiles Destineous which raises 2 random fresh minions (mainly useful for Doll/Beast class).

[b]Changes to minions...[/b]
- Joker Jester: The transform enemy ability now uses a curated enemy list during stages 1-3 (eg so can't spawn a Paladin during stages 1-2).
- Boozy Bomber: Their level 1/2 attacks no longer create fire and level 2 attack uses the same size explosion as level 3 (to create more of a distinction between the levels).
- Azgideth Diablos: Slightly reduced the range at which he will start swinging his sword (so his attack will now usually hit more enemies).
- Morgzoloth Fiablos: Their laser attack sprites are now darker.
- Zogziech Diablos: Their pillar attack sprites are now darker and more transparent.

[b]Changes to relics...[/b]
- A new relic has been added called Sealmentus Staff which gives infinite item Seals and converts any future Seals you gain into +5 Max Health.
- Mother's Milk: At level 1 this now makes you immune to Poison, and at level 2 immune to both Poison and Occult Poison (keeps things simple).
- Skelly Key: This now also instantly kills any nearby Chest Mimics.
- Incandescent Cast: This now also creates a shockwave when you successfully cast a Spell.
- Ectoplasm Poop: The ghosts and their pools will now occasionally fade in/out moving to a new position near you. Its pools have been darkened.
- Chakra Talisman: The shockwave will now nullify the enemy's move speed (so now high speed enemies are pushed back at the same rate as low speed enemies).
- Bustling Diaper: This now also creates constant pools of sticky messes (*sniff*).
- Oily Feet: This now also creates constant flames around you.
- Watering Can: This now pretty much effects every contraption (eg such as even Beehives or Gravestones).

[b]Changes to Spells...[/b]
- Contraptor Spirit: This can now spawn a contraption that hasn't been unlocked and can now spawn it even if it has already reached its max limit (endless chesties!?).
- Suckage Extravaganza: This will no longer suck Souls to you (was rather annoying if you have Doppelgangers).
- Snowblow Snowman: This will now show a player outline if you have that Visibility setting turned on. The duration penalty when used during a boss fight has been removed (so it's quite nice against bosses now).
- Batty Swarm: The bats now Heal you when they hurt meanies.
- Regrowth Returnal: This now pretty much effects every contraption (eg such as even Beehives or Gravestones).
- Sorceric Pillars: This can spawn bigger pillars. The pillars now spawn in a gradually increasing circle around you.
- Bombers Away: Each bomb spawned now has a chance of being a bigger bomb based on the spell casting power level.
- Jester's Delight spell: The transform enemy ability now uses a curated enemy list during stages 1-3 (eg so can't spawn a Paladin during stages 1-2).
- Big Ball of Doom: Changed its description so it's less vague.

[b]Changes to meanies...[/b]
- Player Cloak colours can now be unlocked during play just like hats. So a lanky feller will occasionally show up and drop a Cloak upon death (or spawn Gemmy Lankers if you already have the Cloak).
- Ghoul: They now inflict Poison.
- Bandit: They can now spawn a bit closer to you.
- Mugger: They can now spawn by dropping in from the top of the screen (just like Bandits). They can now drop a Gold Coin pickup instead of a Green Gem.
- Chesty Mimic: They now start with extra Health based on the current stage (stage*5).
- Giga Chesty Mimic: Increased his base Health by +22. They now start with extra Health based on the current stage (stage*10).
- Royal Guard: They are no longer immune from the shockwaves created by the Chi Chakra meta and Chakra Talisman relic.
- Custodianly Champion: They are no longer immune from the shockwaves created by the Chi Chakra meta and Chakra Talisman relic

[b]Miscellaneous...[/b]
- The game engine has been updated to the latest version of GameMaker (v2024.2) which might help with compatibility.
- The way the Fullscreen mode has changed under the hood which should help with compatibility issues (especially when tabbed out of the game for a long while).
- Settings - Controls - Mouse - The Lock Mouse setting has been removed (it now just auto-locks unless you're playing in Windowed mode or tabbed out).
- Settings - Visibility: When set to Minimal it now doesn't show your Score, the Bone count now doesn't show a % sign and is now in the top-right, the Health is moved closer to the Spell.
- Settings - Vignette: The Full option has been removed and the options renamed to On/Off (since it defaulted to Normal anyway).
- Hub - Goblusious: His two options have been swapped around (was a bit annoying having to go to the bottom option every time).
- Compendium - Beastiary: An enemy's stats are now revealed as soon as you kill one of them (instead of needing 99 kills). Enemies that show a decimal Damage/Speed is now rounded up (looks nicer).
- Compendium: The main menu options have been re-arranged so the more used options are at the top (eg Itemography).
- When choosing a Boneraise/Relic/Spell it will now say separately if you have global/local ReRoll/Banish/Seal (eg 3+3).
- Reduced the Gem/Coin sound effect volume when picking them up.
- Roaming Traveller - Beggar Seller: One of the relics will now always be a fake.
- During a boss fight the timer icon now switches to a skull (so its clearer the fight doesn't affect stage time).
- The Healing reduction during the King/Queen boss fights has been reduced a bit (so it looks less like a bug).
- Curse of Chaos: There's a 33% chance a dropped bomb will now be a bigger version. The transform enemy ability now uses a curated enemy list during stages 1-3 (eg so can't spawn a Paladin during stages 1-2).
- Treasure Chests: Bombed Chests now have a chance of a bomb being a bigger bomb depending on the Chest type.

[b]Bug fixes...[/b]
- There was a very rare chance of the game crashing when starting a new run.
- If you have the Display setting set to Borderless Window then it wasn't showing as borderless when booting up the game.
- If you open the Status Screen then open the Escape Menu to rebind controls then the 'Press New Key' text won't show.
- Hub: If entered the Hub for the first time, exited to the title, then re-entered the Hub then the second tutorial ghost would appear despite you not having any Coin meta.
- Hub: Some of the door's pink gems were being affected by the Crypt Paint colours.
- Hub: When interacting with the furniture some of the menu text could wobble until the camera has stopped moving.
- When using the Randomise Cloak colour option it could choose a colour you haven't yet unlocked.
- Compendium - Beastiary: Some of the Bosses Health values were incorrect. The Warble's Speed/Damage value was wrong.
- Compendium - Achievements: Some achievements were in the wrong position and some icons were wrong.
- If you played a run but didn't buy anything in the Hub then the Coin meta may not have been saved to disc.
- Castle Conquest game mode: During the Queen fight the Imp Contraptineer class couldn't change the Giga Treasure Chest contraptions.
- Creative Plaything: Playing runs was still adding to some stats (eg enemy kills and boss jewels).
- Creative Plaything: Removing a Snake Wyrm from your starting legion would leave behind some its body sprites.
- Sinned Deamologist class - Repentant Soul meta: This wasn't giving you the free Soul if you were playing a Boneworld Challenge.
- Psycho Possessed class: When loading a saved run it wasn't loading the Imp Contraptineer's Scrap number and Contraption price multiplier.
- Psycho Possessed class - Soulen Spirit meta: This wasn't giving the Boo Bro if you were currently possessed.
- Meldum Afflicted class - Meldisoom Secretions meta: Its HUD icon will now hide once you've reached the Meldus minion max cap.
- Gangly Grafted class - Bonewrap Miniatures meta: This could offer sacrificial minions that weren't the correct attack type.
- When casting a spell some of the animation spell effect would make use of your cloak colour and outline.
- On the Game Over screen it could show a score that differs from the score uploaded to the online leaderboard due to inconsistent rounding.
- Ravenous Ravine map: The first boss was often spawning inside the top-left terrain.
- Souleater Dealer: His item descriptions weren't being updated if you already had an item he sells.
- Melee minions had a habit of wandering off after attacking a Boss during their attack cool down.
- Brodacious Brozilla minion: When loading a saved run it wasn't correctly adding the Brozilla's regular Bro caps.
- Magma Gargantuan minion: His Status icon was showing too low.
- Boning Totem contraption: Having more than 2 active at the same time could cause issues when raising a fresh minion.
- Desecrated Rage/Acuity/Mysticism relics: When playing as the Doll Maker or Beast Whisperer these relics could sometimes offer a Skelly minion when boneraising.
- Noblemen Lure spell: If a Flag Waver was lured during a special stage then he wouldn't be joined by his usual buddies.
- Made some texts clearer and fixed typos.

tags.feature: - 5 new hats have been added (though are more big head replacements instead of hats): Bigly Barrowerer, Eggplantty Broski, Pumpkinny Broski, Turnippy Broski, Potty Broski.

- Fabellia now has some buyable decorations used to spruce up the Hub. These include a welcome mat, torches, blinged up throne, statue, and boned up or overgrown aesthetic. She also now looks after the Crypt Paints and the way she discovers fashions is now random (so works like Goblusious). The Crypt Paint colours have had some tweaks so are a bit brighter and nicer colours.

- The Memory Skull is now used to load in-progress runs (instead of being asked when starting a new run). The saving is now also done automatically with a tip popup to indicate this (instead of being asked to save every time).

- The Magic Mirror can now set your fashion to global or class specific, so you can individually set your hat, cloak colour, and crypt decorations, to apply to either all classes or just the current class.
- The game mode is now unlocked after beating the King and there's now a tutorial ghost that shows up in the Hub when unlocked.
- Stage 1 now takes place in a new map behind your crypt (so you can now set up a Contraption layout specifically for the Conquest game mode).
- Stage 11 now takes place in a new Wizarding Librarium where endless Seers and a Wizarding Council await.
- Stage 10 now uses the old stage 11 Town. The start of the stage now has some Custodian Bowmen and regular Custodians show up.
- Stage 9 now uses the old stage 10 Bastion and has some new art.
- The stage 12 Lift will now have either a Lunatic Fanatic or Werewolf Prince boss drop in (or both in New Game Plus).
- The Stage Complete screen now shows your Score and how much Score you earnt that stage.
- When selecting a path to travel to if you don't have the meta unlocked for an enemy stage then it will now show a padlock and warning text.
- When entering a New Game Plus it will now immediately save the run (instead of having to complete the first stage to save).
- You now get an extra 61 Coin meta within the first 111 seconds of play (just to speed up the very early game a bit).
- The Map's contraptions will now carry over into the next New Game Plus loop (mainly only relevant for the Imp class).
- When playing a Forsaken Cemetery map the top terrain will now use your Crypt Paint colour.
- A new achievement has been added called Conquest Filthy Stinkin Rich which is for scoring 666,666+ in Castle Conquest.

- The existing Royalty Bosshunter has now been split into 2 separate achievements, one for pounding the King, and the other the Queen (note the King one replaces the existing achievement so you may already have it).

- The various class related Gigald/Gigalicious Pounder achievements are now based on attaining a score instead of just winning the run (to add some strategy rather than mindlessly grinding out safe runs).

- Some of the Mausoleum Awakens challenge runs can now be done in Castle Conquest if you prefer to pound Queeny (Royalty Bosshunter Plus, MELDIN TIME, Horoscopeophobia, Alzheimer Survivor, I Don't Even Know Who I Am).

- Chi Chakra: At level 3 it now creates a shockwave if you were touched by an enemy and that hit would kill you (recharges every 99 seconds). The old level 3 effect which boosts the size of the shockwave and adds damage is now considered to be always active. The shockwave will now nullify the enemy's move speed (so now high speed enemies are pushed back at the same rate as low speed enemies).
- Standards Unfurl: At level 3 it will now double the amount of bodyguards it spawns with. The old level 3 is now bundled into level 2.
- Yer A Wizard: At level 3 the Wizard will now spawn with some Wizardly Seer bodyguards. The old level 3 is now bundled into level 2.
- I Challenge Thee: At level 3 the Champion will now spawn with some fighter bodyguards. The old level 3 is now bundled into level 2.

- Sorcerer Hollow: A new meta has been added called Bookshelf Familiar which spawns a portable Bookshelf minion so you can cycle through your spells whenever you like (to make room for this the Occulto Bookwormios meta has been combined with Ensorcellous Memories).
- Courtier Clown: A new meta has been added called Two-way Mirrors where every 69 (nice) seconds a map contraption is randomly transformed into another contraption.
- Sprout Brotatoes: A new meta of sorts has been added called Heady Sproutage which replaces the 3 existing Sproutage which allows you to grow Bro heads. It also now allows you to grow a Pot head.
- Sprout Brotatoes: A new meta has been added called Embiggen Sproutage which allows you to make your existing Bro head sprout bigger which boosts its benefits.
- Sprout Brotatoes: A new meta has been added called Bonebrobigly Singleton which can allow you to sacrifice a level 3 Skelly when offered a Bonebrobigly Destineous.
- Sprout Brotatoes: A new meta has been added called Soulen Brozilla which summons a temporary Brodacious Brozilla minion when picking up a Hero Soul.

- Doll Maker: A new meta has been added called Waxpiles Gobbler which raises 2 random unupgraded minions when picking up a Hero Soul and boosts chance of being offered Bonepiles Destineous (to make room for this the Waxenmould Flagbearer/Begger meta have been combined).
- Doll Maker: They can now use the Ethereal Rage/Acuity/Mysticism relics.

- Doll Maker: The Bonerous Destineous boneraise can now raise a Beggar Bomber, Elven Enchantress, or a level 2 Custodian. Each of the minions now have an equal chance of being chosen (previously it was weighted towards lesser minions).
- Doll Maker: The Eggy Bro minions spawned by the Brodacious Brozilla minion can now contain Custodians.

- Beast Whisperer: A new meta has been added called Meatpiles Scrounger which raises 2 random unupgraded minions when picking up a Hero Soul and boosts chance of being offered Bonepiles Destineous (to make room for this the Bestial Subdue/Aura meta have been combined).
- Beast Whisperer: They can now use the Ethereal Rage/Acuity/Mysticism relics.

- Gangly Grafted: A new meta has been added called Brodified Behemoths which can allow you to use a Behemoth Barrower for Bonebrobigly Destineous (to make room for this 1 of the Giantous Girth has been combined).
- Psycho Possessed: A new meta has been added called Soulen Boobroski which summons temporary Big Boobroski Bro minions when picking up a Hero Soul.

- Vampire Survivor: A new meta has been added called Batty Blood Bath which boosts all Healing based on how many Batty minions you have (to make room for this the Raise Batspellious meta has been combined with Batty Party).
- Architect Mode: It will now show the Recharge time for the selected contraption.
- The Giga Treasure Chest has been added as a new contraption.
- Reflection Pool: This can now be used to end an active Curse. You now have to interact with it (instead of just running into it).
- Oaken Tree: This will now spawn its own mini-flocks of Bone Birds (so they will still show up even if you haven't unlocked "The Birds And The Bees" meta).
- Soulen Receptacle: This will now transport the Hero Soul to the receptacle (instead of sucking it which was rather annoying if you were in the way).
- Sinful Artifact: This will now fully unbless the enemy (previously it only reduced the Blessing by -1). Its recharge speed has been boosted by 25%.
- Blessful Artifact: This will now only Bless an enemy that is not yet Blessed (eg it can't make Super Blessed enemies).
- Junk Box: This will now always contain a random Relic. It can now recharge after being activated.
- Lexicanium Archive: This is now used to store a Spell (this is swapped over from the Book Shelf). The Archive now starts the run containing a random Spell. Its cost has been reduced to 500.
- Book Shelf: This is now used to cycle through your Spells (this is swapped over from the Lexicanium Archive). Its cost has been increased to 150.
- Spellious Tome: You now have to interact with it to get the free Spell (it starts interactable). It now says the name of the Spell it gives when you take it.
- Cursed Eyeball: You now have to interact with it to trigger the Curse (it starts interactable).
- Restless Monolith: This can now recharge after being activated. Its max limit has been reduced to 2 (from 3).
- Sacrilegious Altar: This can now recharge after being activated. Its max limit has been increased to 2 (from 1).
- Fungal Growth: The Blight they inflict on enemies now lasts twice as long.
- Spiked Trap: Its attack cool-down has been reduced by 150%.
- Gravestone Grace: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 45%.
- Slop Pot: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 50%, however its Mud Pools dissipate 25% faster.
- Fetid Pumpkin: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 300%.
- Ginormous Pumpkin: It now creates an extra exploding piece. The exploding pieces now create their own fires. Its recharge speed has been boosted by 300%.
- Boning Totem: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 100%.
- Honeycomb Beehive: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 25%.
- Treasured Chesty: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 25%.
- Bushy Fruit: Its recharge speed has been boosted by 35%.
- Peeky Potatocrow: Its max limit has been increased to 6 (from 4).
- A new boneraise item has been added called Bonepiles Destineous which raises 2 random fresh minions (mainly useful for Doll/Beast class).
- Joker Jester: The transform enemy ability now uses a curated enemy list during stages 1-3 (eg so can't spawn a Paladin during stages 1-2).
- A new relic has been added called Sealmentus Staff which gives infinite item Seals and converts any future Seals you gain into +5 Max Health.
- Mother's Milk: At level 1 this now makes you immune to Poison, and at level 2 immune to both Poison and Occult Poison (keeps things simple).
- Skelly Key: This now also instantly kills any nearby Chest Mimics.
- Incandescent Cast: This now also creates a shockwave when you successfully cast a Spell.
- Ectoplasm Poop: The ghosts and their pools will now occasionally fade in/out moving to a new position near you. Its pools have been darkened.
- Chakra Talisman: The shockwave will now nullify the enemy's move speed (so now high speed enemies are pushed back at the same rate as low speed enemies).
- Bustling Diaper: This now also creates constant pools of sticky messes (*sniff*).
- Oily Feet: This now also creates constant flames around you.
- Watering Can: This now pretty much effects every contraption (eg such as even Beehives or Gravestones).
- Contraptor Spirit: This can now spawn a contraption that hasn't been unlocked and can now spawn it even if it has already reached its max limit (endless chesties!?).
- Suckage Extravaganza: This will no longer suck Souls to you (was rather annoying if you have Doppelgangers).

- Snowblow Snowman: This will now show a player outline if you have that Visibility setting turned on. The duration penalty when used during a boss fight has been removed (so it's quite nice against bosses now).
- Batty Swarm: The bats now Heal you when they hurt meanies.
- Regrowth Returnal: This now pretty much effects every contraption (eg such as even Beehives or Gravestones).
- Sorceric Pillars: This can spawn bigger pillars. The pillars now spawn in a gradually increasing circle around you.
- Bombers Away: Each bomb spawned now has a chance of being a bigger bomb based on the spell casting power level.
- Jester's Delight spell: The transform enemy ability now uses a curated enemy list during stages 1-3 (eg so can't spawn a Paladin during stages 1-2).
- Big Ball of Doom: Changed its description so it's less vague.
- Player Cloak colours can now be unlocked during play just like hats. So a lanky feller will occasionally show up and drop a Cloak upon death (or spawn Gemmy Lankers if you already have the Cloak).
- Ghoul: They now inflict Poison.
- Bandit: They can now spawn a bit closer to you.
- Mugger: They can now spawn by dropping in from the top of the screen (just like Bandits). They can now drop a Gold Coin pickup instead of a Green Gem.
- Chesty Mimic: They now start with extra Health based on the current stage (stage*5).
- Giga Chesty Mimic: Increased his base Health by +22. They now start with extra Health based on the current stage (stage*10).
- Royal Guard: They are no longer immune from the shockwaves created by the Chi Chakra meta and Chakra Talisman relic.
- Custodianly Champion: They are no longer immune from the shockwaves created by the Chi Chakra meta and Chakra Talisman relic

notes.title: Patch v35.25
notes.content:
There's now a Boneraiser Minions Demo so you can give those raised bones a quick fumble first to see if you enjoy it before stumping up that fat $5.

In the General Settings a new Display option has been added called Fullscaling. It's a bit of a mix between Fullscreen and Borderless Window so you can set a resolution for the game screen which is shown in the middle of your monitor and then any remainder space around it is filled with black. Useful for if you use an unusual monitor resolution and a cluttered desktop as it's a more immersive version of Windowed mode. Note when set to Fullscaling the Resolution option will also change to Resolution Scaling (which you can adjust) to guarantee that the game screen will always use pixel perfect scaling no matter your desktop resolution.

//misc changes (most of these are just to make the Demo nicer to play)
- The "translation_reference.csv" file has been updated (added: MnSet_Gen_Fullscaling, MnSet_Gen_Opt2_Scale, MtCl_Wretch_StartBarrow_Desc2).
- You now get +1 Gold Coin per second you survive capped to +50 (just to speed up the very early game a bit).
- The 2% chance of a run to count as if it was Halloween/Christmas mode has been removed (seems to just cause confusion).
- Boneraise Lore - Readers Digest meta: The Spell related bonus has been moved to level 3.
- Boneraise Lore - Architectual Blueprints: The level 2/3 bonuses have swapped places.
- Some of the second/third row meta in Boneraise Lore and Heroic Force have been moved around (eg Enboned Giant, Meldus Rituals, etc).
- Deprived Wretch: A new meta has been added called Chesty Cough Syrup which doubles the chance for Big Chestibooty Bros to cough up Relics/Scrolls.
- Some of the Depived Wretch's meta has been moved around and the Boner Gang and Soulen Boners have been merged (to make room for the new meta).
- Behemoth Miner minion: You now need the Boned Burrows meta at level 2 to be offered this minion.
- Waxen Elven Enchantress minion: They can now also be raised by sacrificing 2 Keepers or 2 Scouts (instead of needing one of each).
- Lunatic Fanatic boss: Reduced the Damage his big swinging balls inflict  to 14 (from 16).
- The transparency reduction of minions/pickups when there's a lot of them has been slightly reduced.
- The Gold Coin and Gem pickups are now slightly darker.

//bug fixes
- Boneraise Lore - Enboned Giant: Level 2 didn't mention it's needed to raise Giantous minions.
- Deprived Wretch - Nimble Fingers meta: This was giving 3 general Re-rolls instead of them being Relic specific Re-rolls.
- Magma Gargantuan minion: His description was still referencing the Sinner minion.
- Minions summoned by the Giantan Summoner and Giantous Gianraiser were creating smoke effects that were ignoring the Ghostly Minions setting.
- Watering Can relic: There was a chance this wouldn't instantly regrow contraptions if there was a menu screen immediately after picking it up.
- Important pickups weren't flashing when they were about to time out (eg Relics).

notes.title: Patch v35.19
notes.content:
Tis the time of spooks and so a Halloween mode has been added. This works in the same way as the Christmas mode so just adds some seasonal sprite changes such as King Gigald being ousted by the Plump Pumpking. If you hate fun you can turn the Seasonal stuff off in the settings (or keep it on permanently).

The way your Minion's Damage Per Second stat is calculated is now a bit different. Previously it would just keep track of how long the minion was Alive and how much total Damage he'd done and just use that to determine his DPS stat. The issue with this is a minion raised early on would have a lower DPS than the same minion raised later on as more and more meanies spawn later. Instead it now keeps track of Damage the minion does at a couple of set intervals (2 minutes, 5 minutes, All Time) and then uses which ever is higher. So typically all minions now use a DPS set within their last 2 minutes, though can fall back to the 5 minute interval during a long boss fight. This means all minions will pretty much use the same metric no matter when they were raised. The list of minion Damage shown on the Status Screen and Game Over are now ordered by DPS instead of Total Damage as it's now much more accurate.

The Game Over screen now shows the enemy that mercilessly pounded you so tenderly.

A new meanie has been added called the Giga Chesty Mimic who like their little brothers will sometimes reveal themselves when you stray close to a Giga Treasure Chest.

2 new Traveller events have been added. The Curse Wracked allows you to choose a Curse, while the Fortuity's Herald allows you to choose a Traveller Event.

//misc changes
- The "translation_reference.csv" file has been updated.
- Improved performance when there's a lot of enemies.
- Compendium - Artefact Relics: Some relics have been re-organised so are now grouped with similar relics (eg defensive/damage/boneraise/etc).
- The Pumpkin Treat hat is now unlocked from the start and has moved next to the Santa hat (so can be used during the Halloween event).

- Berry Bro / Big Raspiberry Bro minions: They now have a higher base alpha so they're easier to see when their head will explode (in case you have a low Ghostly Minions setting).
- Tamed Immortis Necarch: The amount of ghosts he summons and how long they last for has been increased (so the Necarch's Damage output is more in line with the Werewolf Prince).
- Spring Sandals relic: This now says in its description how long the Haste duration is for.
- Aromatic Mushroom relic: This now says in its description how much it boosts Dashing.
- Ethereal/Desectrated Relics: These have swapped effects with each other (makes more thematic sense).
- Gemmy Lankler enemy: During Christmas/Halloween mode they will now all wear the Santa/Pumpkin hats.

//bug fixes
- Hub: If you played the Clashful Cards tutorial twice in a row then in the Hub it would spawn you at throne instead of the Cards door.
- Architect Mode: The Bigly Burly Boulder contraption was at the bottom of the contraption list.
- Castle Conquest: On a Royal Causeway map there was a chance the Trapsmithy event wouldn't allow you to place any contraptions.
- Some classes that always start with a specific minion was still doing so even if it was Giga Banished.
- Some classes that have meta that boost the chance of being offered a specific minion had its description percentage wrong.

notes.title: Patch v35.17
notes.content:
//misc changes
- The "translation_reference.csv" file has been updated.
- Improved general performance, notably if there's a lot of enemies.
- Deprived Wretch class - Chesty Friendos meta: This now also boosts the chance of being offered Big Chestibooty Bro minions by +100%
- Beast Whisperer class: A new meta has been added called Animal Instincts which gives 1 second of Haste when you are hurt.
- Beast Whisperer class: A new meta has been added called Chuppy Friendos which boosts the chance of being offered Chupacabros and their max cap.
- Voodoo Shaman class - Shroomai Friendos meta: The extra chance of being offered Shroom Bros has been boosted by +50%. It now also boosts the Shroom Bro max cap by +3 (instead of them healing you).
- Boneworm Brainiac class: A new meta has been added called Divergent Invigoration which boosts your Max Health for each different legion minion.
- Boneworm Brainiac class: A new meta has been added called Divergent Invocation which boosts your Max Occult Health for each different legion minion.
- Boneworm Brainiac class - Divergent Deamonic meta: This now reduces the Damage you suffer (instead of boosting your Max Health).
- A new relic has been added called Creamy Trifle which boosts Max Health bonuses and the Berry Bro minion cap.
- All relics that boost minion caps now say the current minion number/max in its description.
- When starting a Mausoleum Awakens some of the classes now have a help text to explain their weird mechanic until you beat that game mode (Psycho Possessed, Boneworm Brainiac, Imp Contraptineer).
- Boneworld Challenges: The following are now seeded so are consistent between runs: Courtier Clown's trick offer, Bonebrobigly Destineous boneraise, Big Potoussy Bro spawn position.
- Boneworld Challenges - Fortnightly Challenge: Slightly reduced the Health of stage bosses (eg High Wizard).
- Meldum Afflicted class - Meldusmania Marrow meta: This meta's counter will no longer show on the HUD (as a bit irrelevant and confusing).
- Ravenous Ravine map: The size of the terrain collision mask used by enemies has been slightly reduced (enemies could struggle to reach you if you stood very close to terrain, notably in the bottom right).
- Travellers Lure spell: This now has a 33% chance of getting a straight random event irrespective of the spell casting power level (otherwise tends to picks the same event if you have a high power level).
- Suckage Extravaganza spell: Minions now can't cast this spell during a Boneworld Challenge (has a habit of ruining the run).
- Chesty Mimic enemy: Pauper and Royal Treasure Chests can now become Mimics (which also affects their stats).
- Zombie enemy: These now count as Human (instead of Beast).
- Bloodum Barrel contraption: Its collision mask at the bottom has been reduced (was a bit too big and easy to get stuck on).

//bug fixes
- Psycho Possessed Unsealing achievement: It's name was incorrect.
- Meldum Afflicted class - Meldisoom Secretions meta: The counter could sometimes be obscured by some unlock tips (it's now moved to the right-hand side of the screen).
- Imp Contraptineer class: The Scrap counter could sometimes be obscured by some unlock tips (it's now moved to the right-hand side of the screen).
- Imp Contraptineer class: The default Contraptor Spirit spell icon wasn't showing if there were some unlock tips showing onscreen.
- If you held the Spell button before and after collecting a pickup then you would need to let go of the button to cast another spell.
- Pickups could sometimes stick to just below you instead of being collected (eg Spell Scrolls).
- Boneworld Challenges: Some decorative effects weren't being randomised correctly (eg smoke particles would spawn in the same spot).
- Berry Bro minion: The berry head would show as fully red when very close to exploding (instead of grey).
- Ratty Orbica enemy: When using the Meanie Outline option it wouldn't show an outline if its close to the bottom of the screen.

notes.title: Patch v35.12
notes.content:
A new Visibility setting has been added called Action Cam. You can use this to adjust the game's resolution during active play (ie when outside of menus and the Hub) so you can zoom out a bit to see more of the battlefield. I'm finding it nicer for when meanies swarm and you might find it easier on the eyes as you can see more in your direct focal point. Note the Action Cam can only be active if you're using at least 1920x1080 resolution and have the CRT setting off, as otherwise the weird resolution can make the pixels look rather funky. It's a bit experimental as it's tech I'm not used to so the Action Cam setting is Off by default, but let me know your thoughts and if there's no issues I might set it to something like x1.1 by default to improve visibility. You can also press F3 during play to toggle through the Action Cam options so you can quickly see the differences.

I also went through all the various Class Heritage meta adding numbers to a lot of their effects so you know exactly what their benefits are (eg so will say "boosts Attack Speed by +5%" instead of just "slightly boosts Attack Speed").

//misc changes
- The "translation_reference.csv" file has been updated.
- A new visibility setting has been added called Vignette which allows you to reduce or turn off the darkness that surrounds the screen.
- Status Screen: You can now press the Menu Back button to switch the selector over to Relics->Minions->Spells.
- The Class/Hat/Card unlock text will now show in the bottom left (so other texts can be seen).
- Hub - Achievements menu: If you weren't online when starting the game then it will now re-attempt to update the achievements each time you enter the Hub.
- Liche Necromancer class: A new meta has been added called 'Bone Banisher' which gives +1 minion Banish each time you raise a fresh Skelly minion you haven't raised before (useful for Banishing all those level 2 upgrades).
- Vampire Survivor class: Blood Invigoration meta: The Running Speed reduction when you have less than 50 Health has been removed (couldn't fit it in the new description).
- Sprout Brotatoes class - Brotraption Waterer meta: The contraption regrowth rate has been increased to +100% (the old +50% felt a bit naff).
- Imp Contraptineer class - Murderous Traps meta: The contraption Damage has been increased to +100% (the old +50% felt a bit naff).
- Behemoth Miner minion: When boneraising this item now won't be overwritten by a regular Giant or Behemoth Barrower offering.
- Mega Meldsumassous minion: Slightly increased its Sight Range.
- Tamed Werewolf Prince / Immortis Necarch minion: To boneraise these now require 2 of their base minions and 2 of their upgraded minions (instead of 3 upgraded minions, so they conform more with the other Soul minions).
- Boning Totem / Cadaver Coffin contraptions: These can now regrow after being used (though the regrowth rate is very slow so is only relevant if you have something like a Watering Can relic).
- Card Catcher spell: This now works differently in that it now has a lingering effect based on the spell cast Power level and will turn enemies into either a Clashful Card for that enemy if available otherwise it simply destroys them.
- Curse of Wrath: When this curse is triggered it will also spawn the usual set of Bees from any Honeycomb Beehive contraptions.

//bug fixes
- Boneworld Challenges - Choose Challenge menu: The Fortnightly Challenge rank could sometimes be weird (eg say "1rd" or "2st").
- Sinned Deamologist class - Deamonic Hooves / Sinful Aura meta: Their bonuses were counting each Diablos as 2 Deamons instead of 1.
- Meldum Afflicted class - Meldantua Invigoration / Meldantua Quickening meta: Their bonuses weren't triggering when raising a Mighty Meldus or Mega Meldus.
- Cyclop Exile class - Mono Giantous meta: This wasn't boosting the chance of being offered Giantan Cannoneers.
- Doll Maker class - Towering Invigoration meta: Raising a Kenshi Shinobi wasn't boosting your Max Health.
- Boneworm Brainiac class - Divergent Deamonic meta: This was giving its bonus for each Deamon minion instead of each different Deamon minion.
- Big Zombroid Bro minion: He wasn't raising new Zombie Bros.
- Tamed Bulok Rider minion: It was counting as a normal minion instead of an upgraded minion which was creating some oddities (such as being sacrificed in a Beastilous Destineous boneraise).
- Tamed Ratty Orbica minion: Its lightning attack wasn't conforming with the Ghostly Minions setting.

Tamed Werewolf Prince / Immortis Necarch minion: To boneraise these now require 2 of their base minions and 2 of their upgraded minions (instead of 3 upgraded minions, so they conform more with the other Soul minions).
Boning Totem / Cadaver Coffin contraptions: These can now regrow after being used (though the regrowth rate is very slow so is only relevant if you have something like a Watering Can relic).

Card Catcher spell: This now works differently in that it now has a lingering effect based on the spell cast Power level and will turn enemies into either a Clashful Card for that enemy if available otherwise it simply destroys them.
Curse of Wrath: When this curse is triggered it will also spawn the usual set of Bees from any Honeycomb Beehive contraptions.

notes.title: Patch v35.10
notes.content:
Boneworld Challenges now has a new challenge called the Fortnightly Challenge which resets every two weeks. Unlike the other challenges it uses the Mausoleum Awakens game mode instead of Necrotic Skirmishes but there's some changes so it's a real hard one to beat. The base difficulty is set to the equivalent of New Game Plus +1 and at the end the Princess awaits who can use both the Kind and regular Queen's attacks and uses the King's map modifiers too. There's no looping to keep the challenge short-ish. To help you on your way you'll start with some extra Skelly and Bro minions depending on the map difficulty, as well as Champions/Wizards/Flag Wavers/Treasure Chests/Giga Treasure Chests all spawn more frequently, and you even level up faster too.

Two new enemies have been added. The 'Gnoblin Lootas' stage now has gnoblin Bulok riders who are faster and tougher than regular gnoblins and their rider will dismount to still chase you when their mount is killed. The 'The Forest Is Alive' stage now has Blossom Dryads who again are faster and tougher than regular Dryads, can poison you upon touch and upon death sprout a poisoned Gem. Both of these enemies require the level 3 meta to show up. The Beast Whisperer class can also raise them so now the Gnoblin and Dryad upgrade paths behave like the Cyclop path.

//misc changes
- The "translation_reference.csv" file has been updated.
- Compendium - Boneraise Necromancy: Tamed minions that require a Soul to raise now have their own unlock hint text (so easier to figure out missed minions).
- You will now start with an extra Skelly minion or two depending on the map difficulty (the later maps were rough at the beginning).
- The 'Full Frontal Pickups' setting has been removed as it now always counts as On (improves visibility).
- Darkness vignette: Treasure Chests and VIP Pickups (eg Relics) now show over the darkness that surrounds the edge of the screen (improves visibility).
- Baronial Bastion map: When the gate has opened there's now an 11% chance a Human enemy will now spawn at the bottom of the map instead of the top (gets very congested at the gate).
- Gangly Grafted Class - Behemoth Friendship meta: Behemoth Barrowers now also won't count towards the Giant minion cap. The chance of the Barrow spawning as a Behemoth has also been increased to 20% (from 15%).
- Sorcerer Hollow class - Chestious Spellious meta: The scaling chance of a Treasure Chest giving a Spell Scroll has been adjusted (eg the chance when you have no Spells has been reduced but the chance when you have many Spells has been boosted).
- Tamed Chomper minion: Their contact damage now inflicts Hex on enemies.
- Watering Can relic: This will now also instantly regrow any contraptions when you take it.
- Sorcery Wand relic: Its max cap has been increased to 4 (from 3), and its description will now say how much of a boost it gives.
- Poisonous Seed spell: Instead of being instantly Poisoned when cast, the Gems that spawn will instead Poison you upon being picked up.
- Card Catcher spell: The secondary healing aspect has been removed (simplifies it and there's enough healing spells already).
- Blacksmithy Lackey meta: The starting Blacksmith will no longer sell a Bernard's Watch relic.
- Chomper enemy: They now cause Poison if they touch you.

//bug fixes
- Hub - Architect Mode: When moving a Treasure Chest to the same spot it would explode.
- Declutter Floor setting: Mud layers and their flames weren't conforming with this setting.
- Some events that give a random minion (eg 'Bonerous Destineous' boneraise) were only checking level 1 for purposes of Giga Banishes instead of the level about to be given.
- Brodacious Brozilla minion: If boneraised normally their Big Bro max caps were counting as double.
- Curse of Sloth: Birds were ignoring its slow down effect.

notes.title: Patch v35.9
notes.content:
//some balance changes
- The Tamed Ghoul / Chupacabro / Big Chupacabradabro minions could give insane amounts of Occult Health healing against late game enemies (notably in Necrotic Skirmishes since enemy Health scales with time), so they now have an adaptive cool down which reduces their healing if they give a lot in a very short amount of time. This generally won't be triggered by normal play.
- Your spell casting power level now has an element of randomness the higher the power level is. This generally only affects the Sorcerer Hollow class at high power levels.
- Sorcerer Hollow class - Chestious Spellious meta: There's now a chance a Treasure Chest won't contain the extra Spell Scroll based on how many Chests there currently is on the map (11% per Chest).
- Noblemen Lure spell: This now has a 25% of luring a random enemy type irrespective of the spell casting power level.
- Sacrificeous Brozillouss spell: When casting this spell any existing magically summoned Brozillas will now have the time they last until unsummoned halved.
- Majick Doppelganger minion: He was casting the old version of the 'Bodily Fluids' spell (which could turn every enemy into Slimes).

notes.title: Patch v35.7
notes.content:
Some bits and bobs to help with visibility...
- A new 'Screen Saturation' visibility setting has been added which allows you to reduce the game's colour saturation.
- A new 'Screen Brightness' visibility setting has been added which allows you to boost the game's colour brightness (this replaces the old 'Light Mode' setting giving more precise control).
- Enemies will now show over the Darkness layer that surrounds the edge of the screen.
- The opacity of minions is now reduced the more minions you have (to a max of -25%). Note this modifier is multiplied by the 'Ghostly Minions' setting so is only really noticeable if you start with a high 'Ghostly Minion' setting.
- The opacity of regular pickups is also now reduced in a similar way as the minions change (this doesn't affect important pickups like Relics).
- The 'Ghostly Minions' and 'Ghostly Pickups' visibility settings can now be changed in intervals of 10% (instead of 20%).
- A tutorial ghosty has been added to the Hub just in case you missed the lamp shade's Visibility settings and to highlight some of the more important options.

//misc changes
- The "translation_reference.csv" file has been updated.
- A new audio setting has been added called 'Elevator Tune' which when off won't play the usual elevator music during the Boneraise/Relic/Spell screen (it just continues playing the stage music instead).
- A new enemy has been added called the Colossus Cyclops who is an even bigger brother to the Goliath Cyclops. They'll show up if you have a level 3 'Mount Eyeball Might' meta where their AoE ground pound attacks leave blazes of fire. The Beast Whisperer class can raise them by combining a Cyclops, Goliath Cyclops, and Hero Soul, and the Cyclop Exile class may occasionally have chance to hire one.
- A new Traveller event has been added called 'Hired Swole' where you can hire a Human meanie to join your legion.
- A new curse has been added called Sloth which just reduces all running speeds.
- Class Meta Summary: This now shows an extra line of text to describe more of the meta.
- Boneraise Lore - Diablos Incantation meta: You can now summon a Diablos at level 1. Level 2 now creates a lightning storm when summoning a Diablos, while level 3 also casts the 'Sinful Incitements' spell.
- Boneworld Challenges: When choosing a Challenge you can now press Down to view that Challenge's Class Meta Summary.
- Boneworld Challenges: If you're currently playing the Daily then the Quit Menu will now only offer the option to Kill Thyself (instead of also offering a 'Quit to Hub' and 'Quit to Title' option).
- Creative Plaything: A new Meanies mutator has been added called 'Meanie Drops' allowing you to turn off enemy death pickups (useful for testing stuff).
- Hub - Goblusious: The Giga Banish magic coins system has been removed (you now just sell Giga Banishes like any other meta).
- Behemoth Miner: Increased the boneraise chance of being offered one to 18% (instead of 15%).
- Magpie Monocle relic: It's ability to remove the border darkness has been removed (it just seemed to confuse people).
- Blooden Cloak / Jellied Eel relisc: These will no longer be active during boss fights (since your base Health regen is greatly reduced).

//bug fixes
- Some generic Direct Input gamepads weren't working correctly (they'd constantly move you up-left).
- Boneworld Challenges: Pressing Back from the Daily Challenge confirmation then opening a Leaderboard would cause a crash.
- Boneworld Challenges: When choosing a Challenge your score/rank was only updating when you entered the Hub (so if you let the timer run down to zero they wouldn't immediately update to the next Challenge).
- Castle Conquest - Trapsmithy: Its controls were still active when the Escape Menu was open.
- Castle Conquest: Giga Treasure Chests weren't forcibly opening at the end of the stage.
- Sinned Deamologist class - Fleshen Masochistism meta: Casting the Sanguine Pickaxes spell would still reduce your Max Health.
- Boneraise: If you had a lot of minions then when being offering a boneraise that requires multiple sacrificial minions it may sometimes not find all the intended minions to be sacrificed.

notes.title: Patch v35.4
notes.content:
//some Castle Conquest changes and bug fixes
- Journey: The bottom path will now typically have slightly less of a Bone multiplier (since it typically has a higher Score multiplier).
- Journey: A Giga Chest special event has been added which just starts that stage with a Giga Treasure Chest.
- New Game Plus: The Queen fight will now have 4 Giga Treasure Chests (instead of 6 Treasure Chests).
- New Game Plus: During the second phase of the Queen fight at 50% Health she will now spawn 2 wall lasers which last for the rest of the fight.
- Being turned into a snowman was preventing the end of stage sequence from playing.
- Journey scene: The town background sprite wasn't showing at the end of stage 11, and some of the minions looked a bit weird (eg Potoussy Bro, Supermassive Slime).
- Queen fight: Her servo laser attack could remain after her first phase death.

//other misc changes
- The "translation_reference.csv" file has been updated.
- Improved CPU performance if you had a lot of Hasted minions.
- Hub - Memory Skull: This will now save the data to a file so the run data will carry over between gaming sessions. It will no longer show the Class Meta Summary (was a bit pointless).
- Hub - Goblusious: The base cost to Giga Banish items has been reduced to 111 (instead of 1111).
- Boneworld Challenges: Before starting a Daily Challenge a confirmation menu now pops up as you can now only start a Daily Challenge once (eg exiting to the Hub via the Escape menu won't allow you to restart it since starting the challenge now immediately uploads a score of 69).
- Doll Maker class: He can now raise the Kenshi Shinobi boss using a Hero Soul and sacrificing 2 level 3 Bowmen.
- Doll Maker class: Each of the towering minions that require a Hero Soul to raise now have a max cap of 3 (eg Lord of the Land, High Wizard, etc).
- Beast Whisperer class: Each of the minions that require a Hero Soul to raise now have a max cap of 3 (eg Werewolf Prince, Elden tree, etc).
- Clown Courtier class - Sticky the Stupendous meta: The frequency of the Minion Trick event will now slowly become less common (since there's less use for it late game).
- Brodacious Brozilla minion: He will now cast the 'Summonous Wyrmous' spell at the start of his Pumpkin form, the 'Abracadabra Hex' spell at the start of his Shroom form, and the 'Day of the Dead' spell at the start of his Zombie form.
- Brodacious Brozilla minion: If this minion was given via a special random event (eg hatched from an Eggy Bro) then it will now randomly choose the 3 Big Bros it adds to their max minion cap.
- Supermassive Slime minion: Reduced the chance for enemies it kills to drop gems (this reduction is also slightly increased for each Supermassive Slime you have).
- Sumptuous Slime minion: Reduced the chance for enemies it kills to drop gems (this reduction is also slightly increased for each Sumptuous Slime you have).
- Meaty Club relic: The swipe's collision mask hole has been filled in (enemies had a habit of not getting hit if very close to you).
- Blasphemous Trinket relic: Added a random delay to the initial spawn so a Heavenly Vessel doesn't immediately spawn on you.
- Sacrificeous Brozillous spell: This will now say what Bro minion was sacrificed.
- Bloodletting Marrow spell: This will now spawn a bunch of Bone pickups around you (instead of it just directly adjusting your Bone counter).
- Midas Touch spell: This will now spawn a bunch of Gold Coin pickups around you (instead of it just directly adjusting your Score/Coins).
- Boo/Pumpkin Haunt enemies: These will now always drop Gems instead of Bones.
- Treasure Chests: They will no longer spawn very close to Hero Soul pickups.

//other bug fixes

I get the feeling the Clown class might be just a little bit busted in the Skirmishes game mode? Made some changes so they hopefully don't go on forever now. Will be going through the leaderboards in a bit skimming off runs that go longer than 15 minutes so top spots should be reachable again, and will keep an eye out for if other tweaks are needed as I'd like to keep him being a crazy class but not outright broken. :]
