notes.title: Mischievous Monday #35
notes.content:
Welcome back wretched. :]

[b]All it takes is one bad boneraise...[/b]
I get comments all the time saying how the loveable Joker Jester skellies are your favourite minion ever. Well jester fans you're in luck for a new class has been added called the Courtier Clown! They are the most chaotic class to play having an aura that transforms nearby meanies and objects and get boosts for raising their fellow Jester chums. They have the unique ability to occasionally be offered to transform one of your own minions into a random other, though the cheeky little prankster also has a nasty habit of forcing you into an item choice you didn't choose (what a scamp!)

Jesters and transformations have had a few changes too. Level 3 Jesters and Deamonic Jesters now also halve the Health of any meanies they transform. All transformed objects now have a random cool down before they can be transformed again and meanies transformed will now retain their previous Blessing level.

[b]New Game.. unforever?[/b]
Just a quick note that New Game Forever has now been renamed to New Game Plus. It's a much more recognised existing term and calling it Forever gave the wrong impression (since sadly nothing lasts forever).

[b]Castle Conquest[/b]
This game mode now has the option of continuing a run into New Game Plus after you've pounded the Queen (respectfully). Since it's already a long game mode it cuts right to the chase so only has the 1 loop but in terms of enemy difficulty modifiers jumps straight to something more akin to NGP2. The Queen looks and plays out differently than in the regular mode too so overall it's all a more difficult challenge than Mausoleum Awakens (though is a bit experimental so the balance will probably need some tweaking).

The scene when travelling between stages is now different too after stage 11 and 12 and your minions are now shown following behind you.

[b]Fresh Bone(r)s[/b]
You can now raise the Berry Bro's bigger brother, the Big Raspiberry Bro. He boosts both your Max Health and Occult Health by +66 and dishes out both Hearts and Occult Hearts when his head caplodes. Both of these Bros now also slightly heal you as they increase your Max Health and will also no longer be removed from your legion after they're finished boosting it so may still be useful as boneraise sacrifices (eg Destineous or Brozilla).

The Giantous Sinner now also has 2 new friendoes so there's now a Giantous for each attack type. The Giantous Gladiator is a straight upgrade to the Giantan Knight, while the Giantous Gianraiser can summon ghostly Barrow Behemoths and Miners (who can even rarely dig up Treasure Chests).

[b]Crypt Hub[/b]
A new advanced bit of furniture has been added called the Magic Mirror (assuming you have the 'Hub Furnishings' meta at level 3). It allows you isolate certain features so each class can either use the default global pool or customise it specifically to the class. You can set this for the Architect Mode and the Giga Banishments, so for example you can have a particular Giga Banishment set up only for a specific class without it affecting the other classes.

Another new bit of furniture has been added too called the Memory Skull (assuming you have the 'Journal Gnoblin' meta at level 3). You can inspect it to have another look at the various run stats, minions, relics, etc, you had during your last run (it updates each Game Over).

A stranger has also been added who sits by the radio (assuming you have the 'Hub Buddies' meta at level 3) who buys and sells Clashful Cards (this is just a re-organisation of the old Card Shop).

The Goblusious's Lost Relic system has now been removed. I felt it's a pretty easily forgotten and uninteresting money pit, and was a shame the relic discovery grind didn't include the best and more interesting relics.

[b]Can't wait to bury my face in that![/b]
Giga Treasure Chests have been added (assuming you have the Bootiful Chest meta at level 3) which will occasionally show up in all game modes. They're much slower to unlock but the prize mega booty is well worth the wait!

[b]Achievements[/b]
The usual 6 class related achievements have been added for the new Courtier Clown class. An achievement for raising a Diablos has also been added called 'Ultimate Deamonic Lifeform' since there was achievements for the other ultimate life forms (note this has replaced the existing 'Lost Relics Fulfilment' so you may already have this new achievement). And there's now an achievement for getting all other achievements called 'Boneraiser Minions 100%' in case you wanted to show off your boneraiser polishing expertise on your Steam profile.

[b]New Gubbins[/b]
• Added 6 new Relics: Bakewell Tart, Flesh Cube, Blasphemous Trinket, Desecrated Rage, Desecrated Acuity, Desecrated Mysticism.
• Added 8 new Spells: Occult Pact, Blasphemous Prayers, Blood Moon Rise, Sacrificeous Brozillous, Summonous Wyrmous, Sanguine Pickaxes, Conjured Bounties, Day of the Dead.
• A new Visibility setting has been added called 'Minion Status Icons' which allows you turn off the status effect icons for minions (eg Haste).

[b]Other misc stuff...[/b]
• If the last time you played was early-ish during Early Access then at game start it will now load in the old save file data and update it to the new save file format (assuming you don't already have a new save file).
• The "translation_reference.csv" file has been updated. Note many of the IDs related to the Spell Scrolls were mistakenly using a "Sl_" prefix instead of "SI_".
• Status Screen: The Run Stats screen now shows the current game mode and if it's New Game Plus.
• The Giantous Sinner and Magma Gargantuan colours have been adjusted so they're less confused with Deamon minions.
• Brodacious Brozilla minion: The chance of the Eggy form hatching Barrow Boners and Barrow Diggers has been increased.
• Deamonic Guard minion: Slightly increased the Damage his attack does.
• Eggy Bro minion: There's now a chance of it being a green egg, in which case it will always hatch into a Tamed Beast minion.
• Waxen Custodian: Increased the chance of them being offered for boneraise (most notably from a Soul boneraise). The level upgrades now require the sacrifice of a Peasant/Knight (instead of a Custodian so it's a bit less confusing).
• Jester's Delight spell: This can now also transforms Treasure Chests into another type.
• Drain Boner spell: This will now give a further random boost of Max Health (previously the amount was static based on the power level).

[b]And some bug fixes...[/b]
• 'I Don't Even Know Who I Am' achievement: This wouldn't trigger as the Beast Whisperer class.
• Necrotic Skirmishes - Choose Map menu: Pressing Up when over the Accursed Cathedral would move you to to Fortuity Destiny.
• Boneraise Lore - Chi Chakra meta: The swirling sprite that shows below the player was affected was being affected by your Cloak colour.
• Boneraise Lore - Keepsake Key meta: This could start you with a Money Bag, and wasn't updating if you won a Mauseleum Awakens or Castle Conquest.
• Forbidden Elevator map: The Heavenly Vessels and Slime enemies weren't using their special spawning animation.
• Forbidden Elevator map: The Elven Wayfinder could still sometimes get stuck at the bottom of the level after attacking.
• Cadaver Coffin contraption: For the Doll Maker and Beast Whisperer classes it could give minions you haven't unlocked via the meta, and could give a Waxen Knight/Paladin.
• Boneraise - Seal: If you Sealed a Deamon minion but had reached the max Deamon cap then it may not Seal correctly (some classes have meta where some Deamons don't count towards the max cap).
• Boneraise - Bonebrobigly Destineous: The random minion it raises would ignore Banishes and if you hadn't discovered that minion.
• Deamonic Jester minion: He was only using his base transform attack once, which was also fully healing the transformed enemy and wasn't abiding by the transform cool down.
• Eggy Bro minion: There was a chance for it to give some of the ultra minions even if you have reached their normal max cap (eg it could give a Diablos even if you had reached the Deamon max cap).
• King Gigald: One of his attacks wasn't conforming with the 'Meanie Attack Outline' setting.
• Shade Mini-Boss: They weren't conforming with the 'Meanie Attack Outline' setting.


Enjoy! :]

Psst... next Monday may well be Mischievous (and jesterful)... :]

//misc changes
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Creative Plaything: A new Meanie Mutator has been added called 'Blessed Meanie Chance' which affects the chance meanies spawn Blessed and Super Blessed (this was previously part of the Difficulty Scaling mutator but is now separate).
- Boneraise Lore meta - Dabber Dash: Level 2 now also gives 4 frames of Invincibility when leaving a dash (makes dashing through an attack a little bit easier).
- Boneraise Lore meta - Sealment Sigil / Banishment Sigil / Keepsake Key: The level 1 and level 3 bonuses are now swapped (so all similar meta levels have: Boneraise -> Relic -> Spell).
- Map hazards will now have an outline conforming with the 'Meanie Projectile Outline' setting (eg the Dungeon Catacomb boulders and spikes).
- Boneraise: It will now show if it's a Spellious Soul and the Spell choice is now made after the Relic choice (for consistency).
- Liche Necromancer class: When boneraising there's now a 66% chance this class will be now offered 1 less Skelly level up than normal (since they have much less use for level 2+ Skellies).
- Gangly Grafted class: When boneraising there's now a 22% chance this class will be now offered 1 less Skelly level up than normal (to help focus his gameplay on Giant minions).
- Cyclop Exile class - Cyclopian Most Wanted meta: The Cyclops now have a much greater chance of spawning together as a group (instead of each spawning at a random side).
- Boneworm Brainiac class: Your minion attacks now have a slight randomisation to their cool down (so minion attacks of the same type are slightly offset).
- Boning Totem contraption: This will now say at the bottom which minion was boosted.
- Ensealment Scroll relic: It's max cap has been reduced to 3 (to conform with Banishment Scroll).
- Contraptor Spirit spell: The chance of it not spawning a contraption has been reduced (most notably if you haven't unlocked many contraptions).
- Deathen Whispers spell: Its description now explains what the Deathen Curse does.
- Waxen Cannibal Shaman: He now counts as a VIP minion for Visibility setting purposes (since he's basically just an Unholy Monk).

//bug fixes
- Hub: The planks that show over a locked game mode door were sometimes not over the correct door.
- Hub: The Heroic Force tutorial ghost could spawn when coming back from Architect Mode.
- Hub: Multiple Architect Mode tutorial ghosts could spawn.
- Hub - Castle Conquest menu: Its unlock text was wrong.
- Hub - Clashful Cards menu: If you sold all of your Cards then tried to play a game then it would cause a hard freeze.
- Compendium - Itemography: The Magma Gargantuan wasn't showing its unlock hint.
- Compendium - Achievements: The 'I Don't Even Know Who I Am' achievement's description wasn't showing its second line.
- Compendium - Class Heritage: The Back button prompt could obscure part of the meta description.
- Boneraise Lore - Journal Gnoblin: At level 2 the Status Screen wasn't showing the Minion Stats button prompt. You could view the Minion Stats even at only level 1.
- Boneraise Lore - Blacksmithy Lackey meta: If you have already used a Meldum Serum or Giantum Serum then he could upgrade them beyond the intended max cap.
- Boneraise Lore - Blacksmithy Lackey meta: In Mauseleum Awakens if you upgraded a relic and there were no other relics left to upgrade then the menu wouldn't auto-close.
- Heroic Force - Goopily Slimies: The Supermassive Slime would appear at level 2 (instead of level 3).
- Status Screen: The cursor when over a Spell wasn't vertically centred.
- Meldum Afflicted class - Meldraiser Spellious meta: This wasn't giving the Meldus Sickness spell for boneraising a Meldus minion.
- Cyclop Exile class - Fixed some stray bullet points in the class meta descriptions.
- Cyclop Exile class - Eye-popper Divination meta: This wasn't giving the Re-rolls for boneraising a Giant/Deamonic Archer.
- Cyclop Exile class - Mono Depravities meta: This wasn't giving the Re-rolls for boneraising a Diablos Morgzoloth.
- Treasure Chests could sometimes spawn on top of regrowing contraptions (eg Pumpkins).
- Haunted Trinket relic: It description was saying it spawns 6 orbitals (its really 5).
- Unholy Tidings spell: The second line of its description wasn't showing.
- Bonebrobigly Destineous boneraise: This could give a Big Bro you have Banished.
- Waxen Custodian minion: When levelling up it could sometimes sacrifice the wrong Custodian. The lightning attack wasn't conforming with the Ghostly Minions setting.
- Giantous Sinner minion: It's boneraise description and unlock hint were referring to regular Giants.
- Boneraise: Sealed minion items that wouldn't count towards a minion max cap (eg raising a Big Bro) weren't being offered if you have already reached the max cap.
- Giantous Sinner minion: Against the King/Queen he could stay below the boss where his bone attack wouldn't reach.
- If an enemy was Super Blessed and was affected by a Confusion aura then he could sometimes face the wrong way.
- Castle Conquest - Queen boss: Her 'Ball of Doom' attack wasn't showing an Attack Outline.
- Elven Wayfinder boss: There was a rare chance of him falling down through the bottom of the map (in which case he'll now transport to the top middle of the map).

notes.title: Patch v34.20
notes.content:
A new meanie has been added called the Supermassive Slime. In Mausoleum Awakens it'll show up during a Goopily Slimies stage if you've max levelled the meta, or in Necrotic Skirmishes it can show instead of the Elden Tree / Snake Wyrm. It's special ability is it can keep Blessing any Slimes near it and upon death will spew out 3 Sumptious Slimes. The Beast Whisperer class can also boneraise it by combining a Slime, Swollen Slime, Sumptious Slime, and a Hero Soul, where aside from being a bigger and meaner version of the Sumptious Slime will also unbless any nearby Blessed meanies (like the Unholy Monk).

//misc changes
- The game has been updated to the latest version of GameMaker (v2023.6).
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Settings - General - Ye Olde Talk: This will now also replace the olde "eth" texts (eg longeth, riseth, taketh, etc).
- The early Gold Coins boost you get for surviving each second has been increased by +50 (just to speed up the very early game up a bit).
- Necrotic Skirmishes: If a Snake Wyrm spawns as the special 4 minute attack wave then it now spawns 2 (instead of 1).
- Curse: A new curse has been added called Climate which creates lots of rain and lightning, but some Slimes too.
- Curse: The Chaos curse will now drop bombs from the sky instead of them magically appearing (makes them easier to see).
- Rainswept Ruin map: Up to 1 Soulen Receptacle contraption will now start with a Soul. The rain Slimes will no longer spawn during a Boss fight.
- Forbidden Elevator map: Beggar Bombs will now occasionally fall during the Gigald Boss fight or on stage 12 of a Castle Conquest.
- Sorcerer Hollow class - A new meta has been added called Powerise Apprenticesio which boosts the spell casting power of Doppelganger minions, and Mad Magus minions have +40% Attack Speed.
- Sorcerer Hollow class - Spellum Invigoratum meta: This will now give Occult Health instead of regular health.
- Sorcerer Hollow class - Spellum Invigoratum / Spellum Speediatum / Wraithen Husk meta: Their bonuses are now based on every spell scroll you hold (previously it was each extra scroll).
- Beast Whisperer class - Sumptuous Slime minion: They now require 1 less Slime to boneraise.
- Souleater Dealer: The beginning Dealer can now offer the Loot Box again, though its contents uses the restricted balance list.
- Tamed Swollen Slime minion: Boosted its move speed and sight range.
- Tamed Sumptuous Slime minion: Boosted its move speed and sight range.
- Deamonic Doppelganger minion: They each now boost your spell casting Power level by +1.
- Deamonic Boomeranger minion: Their orbiting rangs now push back meanies, and you now get 5 rangs that orbit you (instead of 3).
- Brodacious Brozilla minion: There's now some randomness to how many Bro minions their form summons.
- Relics that have a random timer component now have a constant timer (Jewellery Box, Rune Arc, Tinkerer's Toolbox, Potted Planties).
- Blooden Emerald relic: This now gives +3333 score (instead of +1111).
- Occult Juvenation spell: This will now grow Tangler's Occult Heart pickups (instead of just giving you Occult Health).

//bug fixes
- Family Share: Booting up the game for the first time on a separate account would trigger the save auto-backup.
- Settings - General - Ye Olde Talk: Some texts weren't replacing the "thou" word.
- Crypt - Fabellia: You could buy the Random item despite it having no cost. It was wrongly showing the player sprite.
- Crypt: The Architect Mode tutorial ghost wasn't showing if the Game Mode Unlock ghost already exists.
- Necrotic Skirmishes: On maps that have a special 4 minute attack wave they could spawn meanies you haven't unlocked.
- Boneworld Challenges: The new Weekly seed was starting on a Saturday (instead of Monday).
- Boneworld Challenges: The contents of a Loot Box relic and Eggy Bro minion wasn't consistently seeded.
- Royal Causeway map: At the start of a New Game Forever you could get stuck inside of a Big Potoussy Bro.
- Vampire Survivor class - Batty Brew meta: This was only applying its Attack Speed boost to its first attack.
- Sinful Incitements spell: The Attack Speed boost was also affecting non-Deamon minions and was giving +40% (instead of +100%).
- Snake Wyrm enemy: It's body wasn't showing the Meanie Outline.

notes.title: Patch v34.19
notes.content:
// Cyclop Exile class meta changes
- Mono Quickening: This now boosts legion attack speed (instead of your running speed), and Deamonic Archers and Diablos Morgzoloth now also count.
- Hired Eyes: Each Cyclop hired will now boost your running speed.
- Cyclopian Most Wanted: The frequency of the spawning Cyclop has been reduced however now multiple Cylcop will arrive based on the Stage number (so feels more like an attack wave rather than the odd straggler).

//misc changes
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Souleater Dealer: The beginning Dealer can no longer offer a Loot Box (since it bypasses the relic balance starting restriction).
- Lavalous Leakage: This will now also spawn the lava filled meteors instead of just the lava pools (bit more interesting).

//bug fixes
- Escape Menu - Delete Save: The 'Delete all Meta Progression' option wasn't resetting some meta unlocks.
- Cyclop Exile class - Eye-popper Divination meta: This was giving re-rolls for levelling up an Eye-Popper Archer minion.
- Psycho Possessed class: Many class related meta that gave bonuses based on your minions wasn't resetting correctly when switching classes.
- Psycho Possessed class - Identity Decision meta: This wasn't offering a re-roll unless you were playing in the Creative Plaything or Boneworld Challenge.

notes.title: Patch v34.17
notes.content:
// Boneworld Challenges changes
- The timezone used to determine when a new Challenge begins now uses UTC for everyone (instead of your local timezone).
- The Choose Challenge screen now has a countdown for when the next Challenge begins.
- You can now view the leaderboards of previous Challenges in the Compendium.
- Note because of these changes the current Challenge leaderboards have reset (so only leaderboards from this patch onwards can be viewed).

// Class Meta changes
- Class meta that replaces your starting Barrow Boner with a specific minion will now not replace the Boner and you will now always start with that special minion (since some classes like the Imp rely on them).
- Deprived Wretch - Cowardly Rush: This will now give you Haste (instead of it being a seperate speed boost so it now uses a known mechanic).
- Liche Necromancer: 2 extra Companion Chum class meta has been added, however their Max Health reduction has been increased to -20 (to offset the Minion Invigoration health boost).
- Vampire Survivor: A new meta has been added called Batty Dashy Form which boosts your dash length by 25% (and turns you into a bat whilst dashing).
- Psycho Possessed: A new meta has been added called Psyche Invulnerability which gives Invincibility frames after each Possession (the more classes unlocked the longer the frames).
- Sinned Deamologist: A new meta has been added called Soul Dealings Lure which adds an extra Souleater Dealer event to your run.
- Gangly Grafted - Behemoth Friendship: This has been changed, instead each Barrow Boner raised has a chance of being a Behemoth Barrower.
- Meldum Afflicted: A new meta has been added called Meldraiser Spellious which gifts a Meldus Spores spell when boneraising a Meldus minion.
- Boneworm Brainiac: A new meta has been added called Raisen Occulvenate which gifts +33 Occult Health each boneraise.
- Deprived Wretch - Raisen Speedum: This will now give you Haste (instead of it being a seperate speed boost so it now uses a known mechanic).
- Imp Contraptineer: A new meta has been added called Contraptor Suffering which boosts the Damage contraptions inflict by +50%.

//misc changes
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Crypt Hub: If you unlock Clashful Cards before Necrotic Skirmishes then it will now spawn the game mode tutorial ghost outside the Card door.
- Boneworld Challenges: This game mode is now unlocked after getting level 2+ for all Heroic Force meta (instead of level 3).
- Castle Conquest: This game mode is now unlocked after getting level 2+ Boneraise Lore meta (instead of Heroic Force).
- Restless Abyss map: The Restless Monoliths that auto-spawn will no longer do so during a Boss fight.
- Doll Maker class: The Waxen Fighter minion has been split into 3 (Peasant, Knight, Paladin). This is just to make their levelling easier to see but also affects meta relating to having different minions types.
- Doll Maker class: Levelling up a Waxen Custodian now requires the sacrifice of a minion that's being levelled up.
- Status Screen: It will now show a minion's level if applicable (eg for Skelly and Waxen minions).
- Status Screen: Mighty Meldus minions will now show the Meldus max minion cap, while Big Bros will now show their respective Bro max minion caps.
- Souleater Dealer: The title text is now different if you don't have any Souls meta to spend.
- Spellious Tome contraption: This will no longer generate a spell during a Boss fight.
- Magma Gargantuan minion: They now count as 2 for the max Giant minion cap (instead of 1) since you need 2 Giants to raise them.

//bug fixes
- Crypt Hub: The Architect Mode tutorial ghost would only appear when entering the Hub (instead of immediately after buying the meta).
- Boneworld Challenges: If you were Cyclop Exile class offered a Cyclop boneraise then it would show/take Coin meta to hire them.
- Escape Menu: If you did a Quick Restart then it wouldn't submit your score to the online leaderboards if you had loaded from a saved run.
- Souleater Dealer: During a Boneworld Challenge you couldn't re-roll the items if you didn't have any Soul meta.
- Psycho Possessed class - Personality Feelings meta: The next class was showing even without unlocking this meta.
- Psycho Possessed class - Identity Decision meta: This was showing 2 classes in the preview even without unlocking this meta.
- Psycho Possessed class - Identity Instability meta: You could re-roll a possession even without this meta.
- Psycho Possessed class: Whilst possessed by a Doll Maker or Beast Whisperer you could still be offered a Diablos/Gargantuan/Meldsumossous boneraise.
- Magma Gargantuan minion: His Lava ball attack wasn't conforming with the Ghostly Minions setting.
- Behemoth Barrower minion: The Doll Maker and Beast Whisperer classes weren't being offered this minion.
- Deamonic Monk minion: His summon visual effect wasn't conforming with the Ghostly Minions setting.
- Bonebrobigly Destineous boneraise: When determining the random Big Bro it was ignoring the Voodoo Doll's Zombroi Numerus meta.
- Elven Wayfinder boss: On a Forbidden Elevator map he could drop below the elevator after the ballista arrow rain attack.

notes.title: Patch v34.13
notes.content:
Some of the save file compatibility code has been removed which was responsible for updating old save files into the newer format at game launch. If you haven't played since the Early Access days then you may lose some meta unlocks when booting up now, but this is just to test to see if it's the cause of a recent bug that seems to be nuking save files if you haven't played since just before the game's full release.

// Doll Maker class changes
- They can now raise the Waxen Elven Wayfinder boss by combining 2 Enchantresses and a Hero Soul, who dishes out a lot of huge Blight arrows.
- A new meta has been added called Waxenmould Custodian which allows them to raise Waxen Custodians, who are a rare but powerful minion and at level 3 occasionally casts lightning.
- A new meta has been added called Divergent Waxings which boosts your running speed the more different Wax minions you have.
- A new meta has been added called Divergent Wicks which boosts your Wax minion Damage the more different Wax minions you have.
- Championship Invigoration meta: This has been renamed to Towering Invigoration and now gives +100 Max Health for each different towering Waxen minion (eg Lord of the Land, High Wizard, etc).
- Waxen Face meta: The size of the Scary Face's relic aura size is now boosted the more Max Health you have.
- Cannibal Shaman: His dancing aura effect now gives Unholy Protection and unblesses any Blessed meanies (instead of Hasting Cannibals).
- He now has a very rare chance of upgrading a level 1/2 Champion without needing a Soul but at the expense of sacrificing a relevant minion (Knight/Paladin).
- The boneraise icons for the Fanatic and Flag Waver have been changed so it's easier to see their different levels.

//misc changes
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Boneworld Challenges: You no longer spend Coin/Soul meta in this game mode (eg at the Blacksmith, Merchant, etc) so everybody's experience is the same.
- A new Curse has been added called Envy which transforms enemies into random other enemies, and normal pickups into random other normal pickups.
- The requirements to unlock the Castle Conquest and Boneworld Challenges game modes have been swapped around (so Conquest is unlocked sooner).
- Castle Conquest - Queen fight: At the start of the 2nd phase Custodian reinforcements will now arrive.
- Imp Contraptineer: In the Build Contraption menu if you haven't researched the selected contraption the description will now refer you to the Architect Mode (in case you didn't know where to research contraptions).

//bug fixes
- When switching between a Steam Deck and PC the usual Greetings menu where you can set the default controls wasn't showing when you booted up the game for the first time on the new device.
- Castle Conquest: Enemies from forgotten Heroic Force were still spawning as if they weren't forgotten.
- Boneworld Challenges - Rainswept Ruin map: The rain could spawn strangely (due to the seeding).
- Cyclop Exile class: When boneraising if you were offered an extra item then re-rolled resulting in you having less items when the selector was the bottom option then it could cause a crash.
- Beast Whisperer class - Divergent Savagery meta: The Slimes, Wyrm, and ranged attacks weren't benefitting from this meta.
- Creative Mode: When playing at a high New Game Forever enemies would push each other away from each other very far away.
- Creative Mode: Enemies could spawn Super Blessed despite having the 'no supers' mutator on.
- Creative Mode: When building contraptions it wasn't showing or abiding by the max contraption cap.
- Suffering Configuration relic: It's Damage bonus wasn't applying to minion contact damage (eg those used by Waxen and Tamed minions).

notes.title: Patch v34.6
notes.content:
//misc changes
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.

- Skellious Destineous boneraise: This has been renamed to Bonerous Destineous and can now be offered to the Doll Maker and Beast Whisperer classes (it gives a random upgraded minion).

- Blessed Enemies: Increased their Score value multiplier to +22% per Blessing (from +11%).

- Jewellery Box relic: There's now a chance the spawned Slime will be a Swollen Slime based on the relic level.
- Occult Purse relic: The Max Occult Health boost now has a hard cap of 111*level which is shown in its description.

- Brodacious Brozilla minion: Their max Bro cap is now based on the Big Bro minions used to raise them (previously it would just count as +1 for every Bro which could take some over the max cap). Increased the amount of time they spend in their normal state by +2 seconds.

//bug fixes
- If you play the game on a new Steam account but on the same computer then it would copy over the 'back_up' save data to the new account.
- Compendium - Achievements: When using full Mouse Support the active selector was a bit off.
- Compendium - Leaderboards: They weren't showing the usual running Character Class avatar in the top left.
- Keepsake Key meta: This could give the same relic as the 'Re-birthday Gift' meta which could take the relic above its max cap.
- Dungeon Catacomb map: The Boulder could push Bosses down offscreen.
- Cyclop Exile class - Hired Eyes meta: The Cyclop mercenary was being offered every boneraise (there should be a cool-down for normal boneraises).
- Giantum Serum relic: If you were 1 off the Giant minion cap then it wouldn't use the Serum despite showing it as usable.
- Big Potoussy Bro minion: He could spawn a bit too close to another Potoussy making it difficult for you to squeeze between them.
- Tamed Ratty Orbica minion: It was creating a sound effect when attacking.

notes.title: Mischievous Monday #34
notes.content:
Welcome back wretched.  :]

A new map of sorts has been added called the Transitory Elevator. It's basically just the Castle Conquest lift stage but can now be fully played in the other game modes too. The Conquest lift has had a lick of paint to differentiate them, and there's the usual Necrotic Skirmishes score related achievement.

2 new Big Bro minions have been added which you can raise in the usual way. The Big Chestibooty Bro vomits out various Gems and Coins, but also a small chance of a relic or spell scroll too. It also has a nasty bite with any meanies killed by it will also drop a Gold Coin. The Big Chupacabradabro will gift Occult Health and Bones when sucking on meanies, and against Beast meanies any bones they drop will become Big Bones too.

In the Crypt Hub there's now a peculiar basin just below your coffin. Interacting with it will bring up a menu showing all the game's achievements so you don't have to bother faffing outside of the game to see which achievements you have. The basin's fire size and colour indicates your achievement progress and you can access this menu from the Grimoire Compendium.

Fabellia now sells Crypt Paints which you can use to change the colour of your hub. There's also an achievement for nabbing them all.

8 new hats have been added: Nefarious Knight, Cruel Custodian, Shroomed Out, Muppet Mugger, Dung Eater, Wild Wolfy, You Are Here, Honest Holiness.

4 new Relics have been added: Occult Purse, Accursed Tome of Bonings, Accursed Tome of Antiquities, Accursed Tome of Sorceries.

With Goblusious you can now forget any Lost Relics you've researched, which basically just acts like a Giga Banish. The 3 new Tome relics have been added as Lost Relics so will need to be researched before they show up.

The Cyclop Exile class has a new meta called 'Hired Eyes', which when boneraising you might be offered to hire a Cyclops or Goliath Cyclopian mercenary minion chum in exhange for some Gold Coins. The 'Cyclopian Muggings' meta has also been changed so now Human enemies killed by your Meaty Club will also drop Gold Coins.

The Sprout Brotatoes class has a couple of new head related meta called 'Turnip Sprouting' and 'Eggplant Sprouting', so instead of sprouting a boomy pumpkin head he can instead sprout a turnip head (which boosts your spell casting power) or an eggplant head (which slowly gives Occult Health). Like the pumpkin head their effects will remain until you get touched up by a meanie. Another new meta called 'Brodacious Siblings' has also been added where Brozillas will no longer count towards the normal minion Bro caps so you can have some extra Bro chums. These replace the old Cultivation meta which just gave little boosts to some Bro minions so where a bit naff and easily forgotten.

A new rare traveller event has been added called the Master Baiter. As you can probably guess from the name he traps and tames beasts which you can then hire for some beastly pets.

A new contraption called the Bigly Burly Boulder has been added which reduces the Damage you suffer (this was mainly added just to spruce up the Ravine map).

A new slime enemy has been added called the Sumptuous Slimeous, whose a rather hefty slime that inflicts Occult Poison and dissolves into a Swollen Slime and 2 regular Slimes upon their demise. The Beast Whisperer class can also raise them where meanies killed by them drop gems.

The settings menu now has a separate Audio menu for the sound related options. A 'Master Volume' setting has also been added so you can quickly adjust all volumes equally.

Other misc stuff...
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Slightly reduced the pickup sound of Gold Coins and Gems.
- Creative Plaything: In the Necrotic Skirmishes game mode there's now a 'Bone Reduction' option which allows you to adjust the bone value reduction which gradually happens over time.
- If a minion's damage inflicts Meld Rot, then any meldus blobs created from that will be added to the minion's Damage stat (so for example the Mega Meldus Damage stat is more accurate).
- Giantous Sinner minion: They now also require a level 1 Skelly sacrifice to boneraise. He now lobs 3 bones instead of 4 when attacking.
- Megas Meldsumossous: They now have a Meld Rot aura. Slightly increased their Attack Speed.
- Magma Gargantuan: Their lava pools are now darker if you have the 'Declutter Floor' setting on. Slightly increased the Damage their Lava Pools do.
- Chupacabro minion: Increased the rate they give Occult Health.
- Traveller event - Beggar Seller: The chance of him selling a fake relic has been increased but there's now a way to spot the fake.

Some bug fixes...
- Crypt Hub - Boneraiser FM: When using full Mouse Controls clicking outside of the menu would cause a crash.
- Crypt Hub - Goblusious - Lose Relics: The Sinicious Ritual relic was displaying the wrong colour when locked.
- Gangly Grafted class - Giantraiser Minions meta: This was boosting the chance of being offered Big Bro minions.
- Sprout Brotatoes class - Raise Brospellious: Raising a Brozilla wasn't giving any spells.
- Colossal Tooth relic: This was boosting the chance of being offered Big Bro minions.
- Creative Plaything: The game mode mutators menu could have the wrong title.
- Fixed some spelling/grammar mistakes.


Enjoy! :]

notes.title: Patch v33.6

- The game has been updated to the latest version of GameMaker (which might help with compatibility).
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- A new Visibility setting has been added called 'VIP Relic Outline' which allows you to add a colour outline around important pickups (Hero Soul, Relic, Spell Scroll).
- A 'Borderless Window' option has been added to the Display setting.
- A White colour option has been added to the various Outline settings.
- If there's a lot of Bone pickups on the map then fresh Bone drops will now attempt to merge themselves into a nearby dropped Bone to form a higher value Bone. Three new Bone colours have been added to help with this (bright blue/pink/yellow). Note this is only to improve performance and doesn't change game balance.
- The HUD will now display your max Occult Health if it has been modified (eg from an Occult Potion relic) and you have the 'HUD Type' setting set to Full.
- Game Over screen: Above the 'Most Destructive Minions' it will now display the current game mode and map name (since people tend to show off this screen instead of the stats screen).
- Mini-Boss Veterans meta: This will now spawn a Shade Boss during Castle Conquest's Queen boss at the start of her second phase.
- Necrotic Skirmishes game mode: The regular Palace Custodians have been added to the enemy pool.
- Restless Abyss map: Added a little Spirits Abyss easter egg.
- Deamonic Warlock minion: Boosted his projectile's Damage and penetration amount (his damage output was very low against tough enemies compared to other deamons).
- Deamonic Monk minion: He will no longer benefit from the Attack Speed boost other Deamonic Monk's can give (spamming Monks was still a bit too good).
- Brodacious Brozilla minion: Some of his Form sprites have been altered so they're a bit visually  easier to tell apart (Boo, Eggy, Pot, Zombie).
- The Pumpkin Bro, Big Pumpkinious Bro, and Big Potoussy Bro, will no longer play a sound effect when they attack (since they were the only minions to do so).
- Meaty Club relic: This will no longer smash open Treasure Chests and Slop Pots (since it makes the Skelly Key a bit redundant and is a bit annoying if you love your Pot).
- Oily Feet relic: The fire will now always have full transparency (was easy to think the relic was bugged since it's hard to see with the 'Declutter Floor' setting on).
- Horoscope Charm relic: The text that pops up showing the type of bonus gained now shows at the bottom of the screen (so won't overwrite other texts).
- Ectoplasm Poop relic: This will now instead create a ghostly pool that slows and hurts meanies.
- King/Queen boss: During the first phase death sequence you will no longer be automatically moved to the middle of the map (as was a bit disorientating and can cause issues with some map elements like the Restless Abyss's hole).
- Boulder Ogre enemy: Their sprite has been tweaked so there's now a visual difference from the regular Ogres (just so for the Beast Whisperer you can tell their tamed versions apart).

//bug fixes
- Grimoire Necromancy Giant Fulfilment achievement: The Giantous Sinner was counting as a Deamon instead of a Giant.
- Keepsake Key meta: The minion created could spawn inside of a blocking object (such as the Restless Abyss hole).
- Castle Conquest: It wasn't saving/loading a variable used by Eggy Bro to keep track of it was a golden type, and Berry Bro to track how much Max Health boost it has left to give.
- Gangly Grafted - Bonewrap Miniatures meta: This could allow you to use level 3 Skelly minions to boneraise Giantan Elites even if you had reached the max Giant minion cap.
- Vampire Survivor class - Sinfulus Bellows meta: You could go above the Deamon minion max cap by sacrificing a Deamonic Batty when summoning a Diablos.
- Sorcerer Hollow class - Sinfulus Majicks meta: You could go above the Deamon minion max cap by sacrificing a Deamonic Doppelganger when summoning a Diablos.
- Imp Contraptioneer class - Sinfulus Trappers meta: You could go above the Deamon minion max cap by sacrificing a Deamonic Impling when summoning a Diablos.
- Beast Whisperer class - The minions summoned by a Ghost Watcher/Summoner and Necarch would move very erratically if you were far away from them.
- Restless Abyss map: Some enemies were sometimes unable to get around the hole (Slime, Swollen Slime, Bouncy Warble, Chomper).
- Occult Potion relic: If you started a run with this then it wasn't giving you the fully updated Occult Health.
- Ectoplasm Poop relic: This wasn't being triggered when entering a new stage in Castle Conquest.
- Boneraise: The Deamonic Impling/Coiler/Jester description was refering to the wrong minion name.
- Bonebrobigly Destineous boneraise: This could be offered to you even if you only had the 'Rotten Veggies' at level 1 (instead of level 2+).
- Giantous Sinner minion: If you were offered this in a boneraise then you could Seal it and it would show in the next regular boneraise (instead of a Hero Soul boneraise).
- Deamonic Impling: His bulb traps weren't conforming with the Ghostly Minions setting when they explode.
- Barrow Bonebolster spell: For the Beast Whisperer class it could bolster a minion into another minion you have banished.
- Boning Totem contraption: For the Doll Maker and Beast Whisperer classes it could bolster a minion into another minion you have banished.

notes.title: Patch v33.5
notes.content:
//Necrotic Skirmishes
Previously meanies had an increasing chance not to drop Bones upon their death. This is no longer the case so meanies will now always drop Bones, however the value added to your Bone level is reduced instead. This works out roughly the same except this now affects all Bone related values (so for example Bones gained from picking up Gems with a Bonechemist Slab relic will now also be affected). The previous cap of 66% has also been removed so now after the 16 minute mark all bones will be fully drained.

//Mausleum Awakening
The above change will also affect this game mode too (which is only used in New Game Forever loops).

//misc changes
- Keepsake Key meta: This will now treat a Quick Restart as a Game Over (so you will now get the free items when restarting).
- Junk Box contraption: This now just has a straight random chance of containing a free Relic.

//bug fixes
- Vampire Survivor class - Sinfulus Bellows meta: The no-cap Deamonic Batties wouldn't be offered if you had already reached the max Deamon cap, and could be offered even if you Banished it or re-rolled the offerings.
- Sorcerer Hollow class - Sinfulus Majicks meta: The no-cap Deamonic Doppelganger wouldn't be offered if you had already reached the max Deamon cap, and could be offered even if you Banished it or re-rolled the offerings.
- Imp Contraptioneer class - Sinfulus Trappers meta: The no-cap Deamonic Implings wouldn't be offered if you had already reached the max Deamon cap, and could be offered even if you Banished it or re-rolled the offerings.
- Imp Contraptioneer class - Gemenous Scrap meta: The amount of Scrap gained was being reduced if you had the Bonechemist Slab relic.
- Sinned Deamologist class - Repentant Soul meta: As long as you already had Soul meta you could just kill yourself at the start of a game to get the free extra Soul meta.
- Gangly Grafted class - Bonewrap Miniatures meta: You could sacrifice a Level 3 Skelly instead of a Giant to bypass the usual Giant minion max cap.
- Giantum Serum relic: This could be used to bypass the usual Giant minion max cap.

notes.title: Patch v33.4
notes.content:
Some bug fixes and balance tweaks. :]

//relic changes
- Meaty Club: This will now bash open Treasure Chests and Pots. Increased its Damage at level 3. Increased its max cap to 4, where level 4 has a red appearance and deals much greater damage. Each level now also boosts its Attack Speed.
- Blue Candle: Increased the amount of candles it spawns to 1->3->5 (from 1->2->3). At level 2+ some candles become red which boosts their damage, homing, and attack speed.
- Mother's Milk: This now also heals you by the same amount of Poison you have (or gives Occult Health in the case of Occult Poison).
- Chakra Talisman: The size and Damage of the shockwave has been greatly increased. The cool down has been reduced to 33->22->11 (from 66->44->22).
- Stolen Divinity: The chance of it Blessing a spawning enemy has been increased to 10%->15%->20% (from 5%->10%->15%).
- Potted Planties: The falling pots will now always land within the camera view (instead of anywhere on the map).

//spell changes
- Lavalous Leakage: Greatly increased the amount of lava pools created. Majick Doppelganger minions can now also cast this spell.
- Contraptor Spirit: If this is your currently held spell then it will now show a pointer over the closest contraption.
- Noblemen Lure: This will now say which hero type has been lured. The type it lures is now also a bit more random at low cast power levels and will more reliably lure Champions at higher cast power levels.

//contraption changes
- Occult Pillar: The Occult Health healing is now doubled if you are near to it (it glows blue).
- Junk Box: This now won't give a Spell Scroll. It now stores up to 11 Relics in memory (instead of 1) which increases the chance of it containing a Relic, and if you construct more than 1 Junk Box during a run they can now have Relics too.

//misc changes
- Necrotic Skirmishes: The rate at which enemies stop dropping bones over time has been reduced (as it felt a bit sudden). Previously they would stop dropping altogether at the 12:30 mark, but is now capped at a 66% chance at the 14:00 mark.
- Gangly Grafted class - Bonewrap Singleton meta: This has been renamed to Bonewrap Miniatures and allows you raise a Giantan using a level 1 and level 3 Skelly minion (so now it doesn't waste any boneraises).
- Unholy Monk: In Necrotic Skirmishes enemies now have an increasing chance of being immune from his Unblessing aura. Starting at 6:00 and capping at 66% at the 14:00 mark.
- Baronial Bastion map: Only normal Human enemies can now spawn from the opened gate (eg the likes of Cannibals, Elves, etc, will now spawn from the other sides like Beasts).
- Restless Abyss map: Lava and mud pools will no longer spawn/expand over the hole.
- Souleater Dealer event: He can now also offer the following relics: Stolen Sininity, Deamonic Sigil, Blooden Emerald, Ethereal Rage.
- Immortis Necarch boss: He can now perform his special 'Summon Army' attack up to twice (instead of once). When he teleports it's now much less likely to be close to the original spot.

//bug fixes
- Bonebrobigly Destineous boneraise: This could raise a Big Zombroid Bro over the max Zombie Bro minion cap.
- King Gigald: During the 2nd death sequence if he used a special colour palette then it could affect other objects too (eg treasure chests).
- Creative Plaything: When changing map the camera movement was scuffed and minions could be spawned inside blocking objects (such as the Restless Abyss hole).
- Creative Plaything: When starting a New Game Forever loop in Mausoleum Awakens you would spawn inside the hole in a Restless Abyss map.
- Souleater Dealer event: If you were a Doll Maker or Beast Whisperer class then he could offer minions that could take you above the minion's max cap.
- Beast Whisperer class - Divergent Savagery meta: Some minions weren't benefitting from the Damage boost.
- Chakra Talisman relic: The shockwave would not inflict damage and be much smaller if you didn't have the Chi Chakra meta at level 3.
- Contraptor Spirit spell: This could create a contraption you haven't yet unlocked.
- Giantan Summoner minion: The cloud effect when summoning a Ghost Digger wasn't abiding by the Ghostly Minions setting.

notes.title: Mischievous Monday #33
notes.content:
Welcome back wretched. :]

A new ultra minion has been added called the Magma Gargantuan, who is the pinnacle specimen of Giants. He launches his many swollen balls that ooze out with lava which hurt and greatly slows down everybody that touches it, including Bosses, Blessed meanies, and even you (so watch out!) There's the usual ultra achievement for summoning him.

A new map has been added called the Restless Abyss. It is a place of ghosts and Restless Monoliths which will constantly emerge and will eventually activate on their own if you don't do so first. The doorways in this cave also constantly shift, so you best be prepared for a crevice opening behind you just when you thought you were safe! There's the usual Skirmish score achievement for it too.

Some new boneraise items have been added that may be offered to you...
- Barrowing Band: This simply raises 3 stinky Barrow Boners. It's mainly just so you can add Barrowers in the Creative Plaything, and acts as a fail-safe for if you Banish too many of the regular Skellies.
- Bonebrobigly Destineous: This can transform a Bro into a random Big Bro.
- Beastilous Destineous: One for the Beast Whisperer class... this sacrifices an un-upgraded Tamed minion for a random upgraded Tamed minion.

Some class related meta changes and new meta...
- Deprived Wretch - New Meta Added - Soulen Boners: Gives 1-6 Barrow Boners when picking up a Hero Soul.
- Deprived Wretch - Boner Gang: This now starts you with 1-3 Barrow Boners (instead of +2).
- Vampire Survivor - Sinfulus Bellows: This now also allows you summon up to 3 extra Deamonic Batties (they are ignored for Deamon max cap purposes).
- Sorcerer Hollow - Sinfulus Majicks: This now also allows you summon up to 3 extra Deamonic Doppelgangers (they are ignored for Deamon max cap purposes).
- Gangly Grafted - New Meta - Magma Maximus: This allows you raise up to 3 Magma Gargantuan minions, but not any Diablos.
- Sprout Brotatoes - Fruitikeeni Cultivation: This has been replaced with Brodacious Maximus which allows you raise up to 3 Brodacious Brozilla minions, but not any Diablos.
- Imp Contraprioneer - Deamonous Trappers: This has been replaced with Sinfulus Trappers, which allows you to summon Deamonic Implings without need of a Hero Soul, and you can summon up to 3 extra (they are ignored for Deamon max cap purposes).

Other new stuff...
- Added 4 new Relics: Giantum Serum, Hulking Fists, Stolen Sininity, Chakra Talisman.
- Added 4 new Spells: Soothing Esuna, Lavalous Leakage, Noblemen Lure, Poisonous Seed.
- Added 4 new Architect Contraptions: Sinful Artifact, Blessful Artifact, Restless Monolith, Reflection Pool.

Other misc stuff...
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Changed some of the Class meta wording to be more clear what they do.
- Deamonic Giantous minion: They have been renamed to Giantous Sinner and are now classed as a Giant (instead of Deamon).
- Brodacious Brozilla: They now require 3 different Big Bro minions to raise them.
- Money Bag relic: This can no longer be Banished (since it's used as a fail-safe for when you run out of relics).
- Barrow Bonebolster spell: This spell now works with the Beast Whisperer class, in which case it upgrades/multiplies a random un-upgraded Tamed minion.
- Junk Box contraption: Reduced its cost to 1500 (from 2000).
- Bloodum Barrel contraption: Increased its cost to 250.

Other bug fixes...
- Soul Meta: Re-rolling a Boneraise gained from a Hero Soul pickup was giving an extra Soul meta.
- Player: When moving diagonally you could sometimes get stuck on terrain that had an usual collision box.
- Brodacious Brozilla minion: The minions it offered to sacrifice could sometimes be all of the same type.
- Brodacious Brozilla minion: When playing as a Doll Maker or Beast Whisperer some other boneraises would override the Brozilla offering (making him difficult to get).
- Blacksmith / Soul Dealer event: The initial delay before the controls became active was very short.
- Fixed some typos.


Enjoy! :]

notes.title: Patch v32.12
notes.content:
Psst... next Monday may well be Mischievous... :]

//misc changes
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Improved the CPU performance of enemies (notably if there's a lot of them).
- Tweaked the enemy AI so there's less chance of them bottlenecking if there's a lot of them (notably with ranged meanies who stop to shoot which would slow enemies behind them).
- Item Countdown setting: There will now be a countdown after a Roaming Traveller event. There now won't be a countdown after a Hero Soul boneraise (since it's always followed by a Relic choice).
- Castle Conquest - During the stage end sequence off-screen enemies will now be removed from play and you can no longer cast spells or activate Restless Monoliths (to prevent delays).
- Crypt Hub - Castle Conquest - If you choose not to load a Run Save file when entering the game mode then that Run Save file will now be deleted.
- Meldum Afflicted class: Added icons to the HUD (bottom-left) so you can keep track of the Meldisoom Secretions and Meldusmania Marrow meta.
- Rainswept Ruin map: In Mausoleum Awakening they now always have an extra 'Goopily Slimies' stage and start with a pre-built Soulen Receptacle contraption.
- Dungeon Catacomb map: The Boulder will now force open any Treasure Chests it touches.
- Deamonic Monk minion: Their aura which boosts Deamon minion attack speeds is reduced to +25% for other Deamonic Monks (normally it's +50%).
- Megas Meldsumossous minion: You can now be offered this by sacrificing 2 Mighty Meldus (though will prioritise a regular Meldus).
- Bodily Fluids spell: The number of enemies this spell affects has changed so the amount is now linked to the casting power level (previously usually every enemy on the map would turn into Slimes).
- Gold Coins: Reduced their pickup sound volume. They are now affected by the 'Ghostly Pickups' and 'Muted Repetitive' settings.
- Boning Totem contraption: Clarified its description.
- Neighbourly Boners achievement: Clarified its description.

//bug fixes
- Boneworld Challenge: The spawning position of enemies would sometimes not be the exact same between runs.
- Rainswept Ruin map: Enemies were very rarely spawning on the right-hand side of the map.
- Castle Conquest: During a stage event that adds an extra Wizard, Flag Waver, or Champion there was a chance they wouldn't spawn if that stage has a Boss.
- Castle Conquest - Rainswept Ruin map: If there was a Trapsmithy event then Slimes and Lightning would spawn whilst the menu was active.
- Compendium - Minion Boneways: This menu wasn't closing correctly when exiting from the Escape Menu. The Mega Meldus and Brozilla unlock texts weren't showing correctly.
- Sprout Brotatoes - Root Germinate meta: In a Boneworld Challenge the roots were spawning in exactly the same way.
- Deamonic Monk minion: The damage from summoned Bombers wasn't being added to the Monk's Damage stat.
- Eggy Bro: Their colour could change when starting a new NGF loop or new Castle Conquest stage.
- Berry Bro: Their Max Health boost timer would reset when starting a new NGF loop or new Castle Conquest stage.
- Chunky Vomiter minion: In a Boneworld Challenge each vomit projectile would move in exactly the same way.
- Roaming Travellers: In the result screen the Confirm button would sometimes not skip/exit the screen correctly.
- HUD: The Score counter would struggle to keep up with your real Score if you were getting a lot of Score quickly (eg on later maps).
- Psycho Possessed - Possess screen: The background ghosts would move in the wrong direction when hitting the left side of the screen.
- Fixed some spelling errors.

notes.title: Mischievous Monday #32
notes.content:
Welcome back wretched. :]

There's been some changes to the Castle Conquest game mode to spice it up a bit. When choosing a route each path now has a special event. There's a variety of events, such as a Roaming Traveller appearing, extra Custodian Errants or a Champion appearing, an extra bonus to Bones/Score, or a Trapsmithy allowing you to customise that map's contraptions. Stage 11 will always have a Trapsmithy to prep for those pesky Golden Order. And if you don't fancy either path then once per stage you can now re-roll the entire route at the expense of a Soul meta.

A new map has been added called the Rainswept Ruin. In these rainy wilds you'll need to deal with the spawning slimes and lightning storms as well as the usual meanies. There's the usual Necrotic Skirmishes score based achievement too.

A new ultimate minion has been added called the Brodacious Brozilla which you can raise by combining any 3 Big Bros and a Hero Soul. This apex Bro minion periodically infuses the essences of Bros, each colour representing a different Bro. While in this state they gain a variety of boosts and bonuses. For example the Boo essence boosts his contant damage as well as temporarily summons Big Boos and Spell Haunts. For the Chesty essence all enemies drop a Gold Coin upon death, and all Gem pickups become embiggened. While a Fruity essence regenerates your Health and Occult Health, and makes you completely invincible. There's an achievement for raising him called 'Ultimate Bro Lifeform'.

A new skelly minion has also been added called the Unholy Monk who emits an aura of varying effects. Initially it's a protective aura for you, reducing damage you suffer by -20%, and at level 3 the aura will reduce the Bless level of any enemy that touches it by -1. In his deamon form all Deamon minions that touch the aura boost their attack speed and he periodically summons a random Deamon which may even be a Diablos.

A new Heroic Force has been added called Restless Realms. When unlocked the odd spooky Restless Monument may emerge which can be activated at the expense of a Soul meta. Activating it will spawn extra meanies for a short time for if you fancy a bit more of a challenge.

A couple of new class meta...
- Deprived Wretch - Chesty Friendos: Boosts chance of being offered Chesty Bro minions and boosts their max cap by +3.
- Psycho Possessed - Soulen Spirit: You get a free Boo Bro minion when picking up a Hero Soul.

And a few new relics and spells.
- Added 2 new relics (Meldonic Sigil, Mother's Milk).
- Added 4 new spells (Sacrilegious Summonings, Unholy Tidings, Restless Rising, Unholy Prayers).

Other misc stuff...
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Added an achievement called 'Neighbourly Boners' for having scores in both the Daily/Weekly Boneworld Challenges at the same time.
- Mega Meldsumassous minion: The way this is offered is now consistent behaving more like a Diablos offerings (previously there was a chance you wouldn't be offered it, would show in a random slot, and could be overwritten by Deamon/Diablos offerings).
- Blessed Enemies now boost their Score when killed by +10% or +20% if Super Blessed.
- Blight status effect: Some of the damage it inflicts is now based on how much Health the enemy has (so inflicts significantly more damage on high Health enemies).
- When gaining Occult Health, the reduction gained when you have a lot of it already has been removed (previously the more Occult Health you had the less you would get).
- The extra reduction in Occult Health regen when fighting the King/Queen has been reduced (so it looks less like a bug).
- Deamonic Sigil relic: The Deamon attack speed bonus has been increased from +5% to +11%. It's max cap has been reduced from 5 to 3.
- Horoscope Charm relics: The Blacksmith Lackey will no longer sell this at the start of the run.
- Blessed Tidings spell: This now doesn't Bless enemies instantly, instead the spell does it over time (the duration of the spell based on its cast power level). It can now also bless Beast enemies, as well as enemies of any Health, and ignores the game mode base Super Blessed restriction (eg previously Super Blessed couldn't appear at all in Mausoleum Awakens until NGF1).
- Deamonic Jester minion: Added a softcap to his chance of transforming an enemy into a Relic based on how many Relics you currently have (just so you don't run out of relics). The soft cap leads to a hard cap of 66 Relics.
- Sacrilegious Altar contraption: This now has a 33% chance of summoning a Diablos (though he despawns a bit more quickly).
- Fungal Growth contraption: Increased how long enemies who run through it suffer from Blight.
- Custodian Errants enemy: These can now be Blessed (previously they could only be Blessed in the Castle Conquest mode after stage 9).
- Heavenly Vessels enemy: These now have a chance of ignoring the game mode base Super Blessed restriction (eg previously Super Blessed couldn't appear at all in Mausoleum Awakens until NGF1).

And bug fixes...
- When starting Fullscreen if you had a second monitor to the right of the primary monitor it could fullscreen on that instead of the primary (depending on your resolution).
- Creative Mode: The 'Excavator Squad' and 'Barrow Boner-raise' class meta weren't working in this game mode.
- Barrow Bonebolster spell: Casting the spell at a power level greater than 1 but only with 1 Boner could cause some issues.
- Elven Wayfinder boss: He could run into problems when jumping into some terrain (eg Bastion gate).
- Queen Gigalicious boss: Health regen didn't have the same reduction as when fighting the King.
- Status Screen: The relic "Page" text was saying "play".
- Sprout Escapade achievement: It's description was wrongly referring Big Bros as 'Giant Bros'.
- Fixed some spelling/grammar errors.


Enjoy! :]

notes.title: Patch v31.18
notes.content:
Psst... next Monday may well be Mischievous... :]

Added some more guaranteed bosses to various Mausoleum Awakens maps.
- Sorrowful Sullenwoods: The Werewolf Prince will now always show at stage 6.
- Dungeon Catacomb: The Immortis Necarch will now always show at stage 3.
- Ravenous Ravine: The Kenshi Shinobi will now always show at stage 6.
- Accursed Cathedral: The High Wizard will now always show at stage 3.

//misc changes
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Compendium - Local Leaderboards: They now show the name of the current class.
- Crypt Hub: Added a central gem beneath the coffin to fill the gap (it's colour is just based on the class gem colours).
- Crypt Hub - Fabellia: If you have all the Hats and Cloaks then she'll now just give a little speech instead of the usual menus showing (so it's quicker to see if you have everything).
- Immortis Necarch boss: He had a very low chance of appearing if you haven't yet killed him and hadn't triggered the boss progression system.
- Burly Boulder contraption: Updated their sprite so there's more variety and a bit spookier.
- Castle Conquest - Stage 11 Lift: The 'Echo of the Wilds' spell can now spawn Bees and Shrooms.
- Castle Conquest - Queen Gigalicious: Upon her 1st phase death her jewel attack would remain active.
- Bellow Batty minion: Their attacks weren't inflicting damage at Level 2.
- Big Potoussy Bro minion: There was a very small chance of you getting stuck inside the Potoussy (oh no!)

//bug fixes
- Blacksmithy Lackey meta: He could create a very long freeze or complete freeze if he didn't have enough viable items to offer.
- Boneworld Challenges: Forgetting Boneraise Lore or Class Meta wasn't counting as unlocked during the Challenge.
- Damage Numbers: Minion attacks that are persistent were giving inaccurate numbers (eg Grave Guard sword swipes).
- Goblusious - Giga Banish menu: If you banished an item and moved the selector on the same frame then it could banish an item you haven't yet discovered (which would also prevent you from unbanishing it).
- Castle Conquest - Stage 11 Lift: Roaming Traveller events weren't spawning enemies (eg Lost Little Flag).
- Mausoleum Awakens - Unsanctified Crypt map: The Immortis Necarch could appear as bosses at both stage 3 and 6.
- Mausoleum Awakens - Royal Causeway map: The Lunatic Fanatic was spawning as the stage 6 boss instead of stage 3.
- Boneworm Brainiac class - Freshen Melilous meta: This bonus was applying with each fresh boneraise even if the minion wasn't Melee.
- Boneworm Brainiac class - Freshen Magilous meta: This bonus was applying with each fresh boneraise even if the minion wasn't Magic.
- Boneworm Brainiac class - Freshen Ranilous meta: This bonus was applying with each fresh boneraise even if the minion wasn't Ranged.
- Boneworm Brainiac class - Raisen Rejuvenate meta: If you gain a Max Health boost from Freshen Melilous then this meta wouldn't fully heal you.
- Boneworm Brainiac class - Divergent Deamonic meta: Raising a Deamonic Giantous would give double the usual Max Health boost. Clarified in its description that the meta is triggered when raising the minion.

- Boneworm Brainiac class - Freshen Magilous meta: This bonus was applying with each fresh boneraise even if the minion wasn't Magic.

notes.title: Patch v31.15
notes.content:
//in the never-ending saga of the mysterious save file wipes...
- The save file has now been split into 2 files. The 'save_meta.dat' stores the important meta unlocks, while the 'save.dat' file stores everything else.
- The Beastiary Kills data now won't be immediately updated every time an enemy is killed, and is instead saved collectively when you enter the Crypt Hub (this is to greatly reduce the amount of save file writing).

//misc changes
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Added a "Tabbed Pause" setting which when On will open the Escape Menu if the game doesn't currently have focus and the gameplay isn't already paused.
- Boneraise Lore - Bootiful Chest: At level 3 instead of allowing the buying of Soul Meta it's now needed for the Treasure Chests to have their base special item (since there's the Piggy Bank for buying Souls).
- Liche Escapade achievement: This has been simplified a bit so now you need at least 13 different types of level 1 Skelly minion, instead of every type (so you're not faffing around with the Compendium).
- King Gigald Bosshunter achievement: This has been changed to 'Royalty Bosshunter' which will trigger after killing both the King and Queen (since there's already class achievements for just killing the King).
- Crypt Hub - Goblusious the Scholastic: There's now a percentage beside the options (so it's easy to see if there's anything that can still be done).
- Crypt Hub - Choose Class: The Fortuity Destiny now has it's own gemless sprite (so people don't think it can get gems).
- New Game Forever: NGF1 now has its own ending text (so it's less likely you'll skip the NGF2 ending text).
- New Game Forever: When starting a new loop any contraptions that changed in the previous loop will now revert back to their starting type (this does not apply to the Imp Contraptioneer class).
- Status Screen: The legion title will now say what class you are (eg Thy Deprived Wretch Legion).
- Blacksmithy Lackey / Souleater Dealer meta: These will now show even if you don't have any Coins/Souls (so people don't think them not showing up is a bug when you first unlock them).
- The speed you gain Bone level ups has been increased if you picked up a lot of Bones quickly.
- Mauseleum Awakens - Gaseous Chompers stage: Increased the amount of Chompers that spawn.
- Cyclop Exile: During a Mauseleum Awakens he'll now always fight an extra stage of 'Mount Eyeball Might'.
- Treasure Chests: Meta and Relics that give a chance for chests to drop Spells/Relics now have the same chance irrespective of the type of chest (eg previously brown chests had a lower chance of giving free items).
- The Deamonic Augur, Fruity Bro, and Big Fruitikeeni Bro will now always have full transparency (so easier to see).
- Big Boobroski Bro minion: Reduced the size of his wall collision mask (as would sometimes get stuck).
- Bustling Diaper relic: You now release a sticky mess when Super Dashing too (*sniff*).
- Bonechemist Slab relic: This now says in its description how many Bones you get.
- Barrow Bonebolster spell: This can now level up the same minion multiple times if the spell cast has enough power level and Barrow Boners.
- Elven Wayfinder boss: He'll now adjust his aim if you attempt to run below or above him (otherwise he's too easy).
- Roaming Travellors: They now won't immediately appear if you're currently busy (eg super dashing or are a snowman).
- Roaming Traveller - Lost Little Flag: It now has a Barrow Boner icon when choosing the option (so you know what you're sacrificing).

//bug fixes
- Giantan Summoner minion: He could cause a game freeze if the target of his attack was inside a solid object.
- Fixed several issues where translated text weren't showing correctly.
- Cloak Skin: Changing the colour of your cloak wasn't working if you were using a translation that changed the cloak names.
- Killing a lot of enemies at the same time was causing mini-stuttering (as it was constantly updating the Beastiary save file after every kill).
- Keepsake Key meta: This wasn't spawning its free minion. It was also updating in the Creative Plaything mode.
- Castle Conquest - Cursen Eye contraption: This could trigger a Curse during the stage end sequence causing issues.
- Boneworld Challenges: Fixed a seeding issue that would often offer the same combinations of relic/spells/minions.
- Creative Plaything - Starting Legion: When removing a minion it would sometimes remove a minion of the same type but not of the same level. Fixed some inconsistent naming when choosing the starting minions.
- Creative Plaything - If the Fortuity Destiny class was selected in the Crypt Hub then you would enter the Creative Plaything as a random class instead of that selected in the Plaything menu.
- Sinned Deamologist - Repentant Soul meta: This was giving a free Soul in the Creative Plaything mode.
- Imp Contraptioneer: You couldn't buy a contraption if the scrap cost was exactly the same as your current scrap.
- Imp Contraptioneer - Contraptor Salvager meta: If you bought a contraption on an empty spot then it would reduce your scrap by one extra.
- Imp Contraptioneer - Using Deconstruct would still give you 50% of the contraption's worth in Scrap even if you didn't have the Contraptor Salvager meta.
- Junk Box contraption: This was updating in the Creative Plaything mode.
- Roaming Traveller - Miserable Wretch: The Barrow Boner icon was being partially cut off by the text.
- During a Roaming Traveller event or when offered a boneraise/relic/spell the stage music would sometimes not pause.
- Werewolf Prince boss: His swipe attack didn't have a sound effect.

notes.title: Patch v31.11
notes.content:
New Game Forever is now not quite forever as after pounding the King 3 times even he gives up (not that it's expected you'll survive that long but at least it guarantees a max play time). If you don't want it to end though the Creative Plaything now has a new 'Truly Forever' option for it to ignore the cap. There's been quite a lot of changes and rebalances too since the Early Access so I also went through the various NGF leaderboards skimming off runs that went beyond NGF2 so it's more of a level playing field.

//other New Game Forever changes
- The extra +50% Health boost bosses get in NGF has been reduced to +20% (mainly as the King Gigald fight dragged on rather too long).
- King Gigald: The score bonus for killing him is now multiplied by the NGF loop.
- King Gigald: There's now a small delay to his starting attacks based on how many Shade bosses spawn (to give a little breather before the chaos).

//misc changes
- Updated to the latest version of GameMaker (might improve compatibility).
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- The save backup system can now detect partial save file wipes, in which case it's treated as a fully wiped save.
- The backup save file will now only be updated after you've died once (so just entering the hub then exiting won't trigger it).
- King Gigald: Increased the score bonus from killing him to 25000 per phase (increased from 10000).
- Queen Gigalicious: Increased the score bonus from killing her to 50000 per phase (increased from 20000).
- Doll Maker class: The chance of being offered Cannibal/Bandit when boneraising is now more consistent (since they now override base upgrade offerings).
- Dryad enemy: Upon death they now grow an Elden Tree root.
- Heavenly Vessels enemy: They now have additional 22% chance of being blessed.
- Horoscope Charm relic / Blanked Scroll spell: These now have a collective soft cap on the Banishes they can give (the more Banishes they give the less chance of them giving another until a hard cap of 9).
- Scavvy Mitts relic: The starting Blacksmith will no longer sell this relic.
- Deboning Cutlery relic: Changed the description so it's clear it's a Skelly minion that will be raised.
- Spellious Spewious spell: This now can't give a Spellious Spewious spell.

//bug fixes
- Some minion attacks weren't conforming with the Ghostly Minions setting.
- Castle Conquest: It was possible for a Curse to trigger during the end stage sequence which could cause issues.
- Castle Conquest: Loading a game would sometimes not remove all of your spells from the previous run.
- Keepsake Key meta: It could give a non-normal starting minion for Doll Maker and Beast Whisperer classes.
- Confused enemies that have a ranged attack were still able to run towards you and use their ranged attacks.
- Goblusious the Scholastic: Fixed some text issues.

- Dark Metaman class: There were 2 metas called 'Soulen Embolden' (one has been renamed to 'Soulen Invigorati').

notes.title: Mischievous Monday #30
notes.content:
Welcome back wretched. :]

Spent much of the week working on the new final game mode which will be coming in the game's full release this Thursday, so just some bits and bobs in today's update finishing various stuff off. And to answer a common question from last weeks update, nope this won't be the last Monday that's mischievous.

Some little sneak peeks of the new game mode...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42164750/727a9c10dbc48d558de7e0b747c35138572d028e.png[/img]

And now on with the update!

I've been getting some strange and spooky reports of Windows 11 users running into a BSOD which also deletes their save file. I've now updated GameMaker to the latest version which hopefully might improve compatibility for various issues (BSOD, PS5 pad, HDMI audio). Fingers crossed.

The game will now also make a backup copy of your save file each time you die. This is stored as "save_backup.dat" in the usual place your save files are stored. This backup file isn't linked to Steam's Cloud Saves so won't be overwritten or synced with Steam. If your original save file becomes corrupted you can just copy over the data from the backup file into the normal save file.

[b]Mausoleum Awakening - New Game Forever changes...[/b]
- All forms of healing, except full heals, will now heal less with each NGF loop starting at NGF+2 (x0.8 -> x0.4 -> x0.1).
- Enemies now have a greater range they push other enemies away from them with each NGF loop (so they bunch up in the middle of the map less).

[b]Beast Whisperer class changes...[/b]
- They can now beastraise Lantern Handler and Candle Ghosts for if you want to watch the world burn.
- They can now also beastraise Ghost Watchers, Ghost Summoners and the Immortis Necarch, who conjure armies of lost souls to fight for them.
- They now won't be offered the Barrow Bonebolster spell (since it's useless).

[b]Other misc stuff...[/b]
- Updated the "translation_reference.csv" file.
- Added 5 new relics: Ethereal Rage, Ethereal Acuity, Ethereal Mysticism, Focal Flute, Moon Trinket.
- Added 2 new Traveller events: Spellious Dealer, Lost Little Flag.
- Crypt Hub: Changed the gems on the Boneworld Challenges door (so it's easier to tell apart from the Skirmishes doorway).
- Crypt Hub: Added a little flavour text when entering the Mausoleum Awakening game mode (since there's no mention of the game mode name).
- The Status Screen and when choosing a new relic will now show the max cap for the selected relic if you have one already.
- Wolf Prince boss: Greatly reduced the rate his running speed increases over time (note the speed he moves as he performs the swipe attack hasn't been reduced).
- Flag Waver enemy: Increased the amount of enemies that arrive with him (especially at lower levels).
- Virginial Bow relic: Increased how many bones are needed per heal (so you don't have to deal with decimals). Removed the hard cap on how much it can heal in Awaken NGF and Skirmishes.
- Deamonic Jester minion: There's now a cool down after being transformed into a snowman (so you're not constantly transformed).
- Waxen Lunatic Fanatic minion: He will now slow down nearby enemies (in a similar way to lesser Fanatics).
- Bernard's Watch relic: Decreased the amount of seconds of invincibility by -1 (the full 5 seconds was a bit much).
- Mausoleum Awakening - Royal Causeway map: The stage 3 boss will now always be a Lunatic Fanatic.
- Beastiary: Added 2 enemies: Chesty Mimic, Gemmy Lankler.
- Beastiary: The Big Pumpkin/Boo Haunts now require 9 kills to reveal their info (instead of 99 since they are a rare enemy).

[b]And bug fixes...[/b]
- Fixed some spelling errors.
- Compendium: Loading the Necrotic Skirmishes local leaderboard would cause a crash.
- Compendium: It wasn't loading the Mausoleum Awakening online leaderboard scores correctly.
- Escape Menu - Quit: This menu would become unresponsive if using a translation.
- Playing in the Creative Plaything and then quitting to play another game mode would not trigger some relic effects (eg Forged Soul).
- Doll Maker class: Shamans/Muggers would still be offered after being Banished.
- Psycho Possessed class: When transforming into another class it would reset your invincibility frames (eg from a Bottled Fairy).
- Beast Whisperer class: Some of the Tamed minions weren't displaying their name and description in the Status Screen (eg Tamed Elden Tree).
- King Gigald: There was a graphical glitch when he was attacking.
- King Gigald - Lase Orbit attack: The attack could cause damage as soon as they spawned (instead of only when the laser is wide).
- Dungeon Catacomb map: If you beat the King as a boulder was moving past you then the boulder sound would continue throughout the Congratulations screen.
- Roaming Traveller: If you didn't have enough meta then a traveller event wouldn't show up despite it saying so (it will now default to Miserable Wretch).
- Flag Waver enemy: Low level Flag Wavers could make nearby fast moving enemies slower.
- Beastiary: The Zombie Knight's name was wrong.


Enjoy! :]
